title: AI & ML Senior Researcher (Re Announced)
description:
Job Summary
Key Responsibilities:
· Lead research and experimentation in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.
· Design, develop, train, and evaluate advanced AI/ML models and algorithms.
· Identify and explore new AI/ML methods, technologies, and research opportunities.
· Develop prototypes and convert research findings into practical and scalable solutions.
· Conduct model testing, benchmarking, validation, and performance optimization.
· Work with large, complex, structured, and unstructured datasets for research and model development.
· Collaborate with data engineering, software development, cybersecurity, and infrastructure teams to integrate AI solutions into systems and applications.
· Ensure AI/ML solutions consider security, privacy, reliability, explainability, and responsible AI practices.
· Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior AI/ML researchers and engineers.
· Prepare and maintain research documentation, technical reports, experiment results, and model documentation.
· Evaluate open-source AI technologies and develop solutions that support self-hosted and locally sustainable systems.
· Support the organization in developing AI solutions relevant to local operational needs and Afghanistan’s technology environment.

Job Requirements
Required Qualifications:
· PhD in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Data Science, or a closely related field.
· Strong knowledge of machine learning, deep learning, statistical modeling, and AI algorithms.
· Proven experience designing, training, evaluating, and optimizing AI/ML models.
· Strong programming skills in Python and experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, Tensor Flow, or JAX.
· Experience with large datasets, data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation.
· Strong understanding of NLP, computer vision, generative AI, or other relevant AI domains.
· Knowledge of model explainability, responsible AI, privacy, security, and bias evaluation.
· Experience with research methodology, experimentation, benchmarking, and technical documentation.
· Familiarity with MLOps, model deployment, version control, and production AI workflows.
· Ability to work with self-hosted, on premise, cloud, or hybrid AI infrastructure.
· Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and technical leadership skills.
· Ability to collaborate effectively with data engineering, software development, cybersecurity, and infrastructure teams.
Preferred Qualifications:
· PhD or advanced research background in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field.
· Published research in reputable journals, conferences, or technical platforms.
· Experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), NLP, computer vision, or multimodal AI systems.
· Experience fine-tuning, evaluating, and optimizing open-source AI models.
· Knowledge of distributed training, GPU computing, and high-performance AI infrastructure.
· Experience with MLOps, model deployment, monitoring, and production AI systems.
· Familiarity with self-hosted, on premise, and privacy-focused AI solutions.
· Experience leading AI/ML research projects and mentoring junior researchers or engineers.
· Knowledge of responsible AI, model safety, explainability, bias mitigation, and data privacy.
· Relevant professional certifications or specialized training in AI, ML, cloud, or advanced computing are an advantage.
Plus, Points:
· Experience with open-source LLMs and self-hosted AI platforms.
· Hands-on experience with GPU servers, distributed training, and model optimization.
· Experience developing AI solutions for low-resource languages, especially Pashto and Dari.
· Knowledge of RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and AI agent systems.
· Experience with edge AI, offline AI, or limited-connectivity environments.
· Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or research communities.
· Experience building AI solutions for local, regional, or developing-market challenges.
· Strong understanding of AI security, adversarial ML, and model protection.
Experience Requirement:
· Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or applied research.
· Proven experience in designing, training, evaluating, and optimizing advanced AI/ML models.
· Experience conducting research, experimentation, benchmarking, and model validation.
· Practical experience with deep learning, NLP, computer vision, generative AI, or LLM-based systems.
· Experience working with large datasets, GPU-based computing, and AI/ML frameworks.
· Experience deploying or integrating AI/ML models into real-world or production systems.
· Experience leading research projects and providing technical guidance or mentorship to junior team members.
· Experience collaborating with data engineering, software development, cybersecurity, and infrastructure teams.
· Experience with self-hosted, on premise, cloud, or hybrid AI environments is preferred.
What We Offer:
· Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
· Opportunity to lead advanced AI/ML research and innovation projects.
· Access to modern AI tools, GPU infrastructure, and research resources.
· Hands-on work with self-hosted, privacy-focused, and locally sustainable AI systems.
· Opportunities for professional development, research growth, and technical leadership.
· Collaboration with data engineering, software development, cybersecurity, and infrastructure teams.
· Opportunity to develop AI solutions for Pashto, Dari, and other locally relevant challenges.
· Opportunity to contribute to independent and innovative technology solutions for Afghanistan.

Submission Guideline
Applicants are required to mention the Job Title and Vacancy # in the subject line of their email. Please attach your updated CV and a cover letter and send them to hr@ibtekarmind.com , with a copy (CC) to Ibtekarmind2026@gmail.com . The application deadline is 20-November-2026, so ensure your submission is sent before this date.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview and a demo session. We look forward to receiving your applications .

title: Cybersecurity Expert (Re Announced)
description:
Job Summary
Key Responsibilities:
· Perform application security assessments, vulnerability testing, and code security reviews.
· Identify, analyze, prioritize, and support remediation of security vulnerabilities in web, mobile, API, and backend applications.
· Integrate security controls and best practices throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
· Review application architecture, APIs, authentication, authorization, session management, and data protection mechanisms.
· Work closely with software development, DevOps, QA, infrastructure, and cybersecurity teams to implement secure development practices.
· Provide secure coding guidance and support developers in resolving identified security issues.
· Monitor emerging application security threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques.
· Support security testing before application releases and major system changes.
· Maintain application security documentation, vulnerability reports, risk assessments, and remediation tracking.
· Support incident investigation and root-cause analysis for application-related security events.
· Ensure applications follow recognized security standards and best practices, including OWASP guidelines and secure coding principles.

Job Requirements
Required Qualifications:
· Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. A Master’s degree is preferred.
· Strong understanding of application security principles, secure coding practices, and common software vulnerabilities.
· Knowledge of OWASP Top 10, API security, authentication, authorization, session management, and data protection.
· Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, vulnerability scanning, and application security testing tools.
· Familiarity with programming or scripting languages such as Python, kotlin, Java, JavaScript, C#, PHP, or similar technologies.
· Experience assessing the security of web applications, mobile applications, APIs, and backend services.
· Understanding of secure SDLC, threat modeling, code review, and vulnerability management.
· Knowledge of networking, operating systems, databases, encryption, and security protocols.
· Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, and containerized environments.
· Ability to analyze security findings, determine risk, and provide practical remediation recommendations.
· Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
· Ability to collaborate effectively with development, DevOps, QA, infrastructure, and cybersecurity teams.
Preferred Qualifications:
· Hands-on experience in web and API application security testing.
· Practical knowledge of OWASP Top 10 and common application vulnerabilities.
· Experience with manual penetration testing and vulnerability assessment.
· Practical experience with tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nmap, or similar tools.
· Basic experience with secure code review and secure coding practices.
· Knowledge of authentication, authorization, session management, input validation, and data protection.
· Familiarity with Android and iOS application security is an advantage.
· Experience working with developers to identify and remediate application security issues.
· Relevant cybersecurity training or certification such as CEH, Security+, eJPT, or equivalent is an advantage.
Plus, Points:
· Experience with Android and iOS application security testing.
· Familiarity with API security testing and common API vulnerabilities.
· Basic knowledge of secure code review in languages such as Java, Kotlin, JavaScript, PHP, or Python.
· Hands-on experience with Burp Suite and/or OWASP ZAP; familiarity with MobSF or similar mobile application security tools is an advantage.
· Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, and DevSecOps practices.
· Experience participating in CTFs, bug bounty programs, or practical security labs.
· Knowledge of application authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure data storage.
· Experience working directly with developers to verify and remediate security findings.
· Relevant application-security training or certification is an advantage.
Experience Requirement:
· 5+ years of relevant experience in application security, penetration testing, or secure software development.
· Hands-on experience in web and API security testing.
· Practical experience identifying, assessing, and supporting remediation of application vulnerabilities.
· Experience using tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, or similar application security tools.
· Experience with OWASP Top 10, secure coding practices, and vulnerability assessment.
· Experience working with developers to verify, prioritize, and remediate security findings.
· Experience with mobile application security testing for Android or iOS is an advantage.
· Familiarity with secure SDLC, code review, and application security testing before release is preferred.
What We Offer:
· Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
· Hands-on work with real-world application security projects.
· Opportunities to strengthen skills in web, API, and mobile application security.
· Access to practical security testing tools and secure development environments.
· Collaboration with software development, DevOps, QA, and cybersecurity teams.
· Opportunities for technical training, professional development, and career growth.
· Opportunity to contribute to secure, locally developed, and self-hosted applications.

Submission Guideline
Applicants are required to mention the Job Title and Vacancy # in the subject line of their email. Please attach your updated CV and a cover letter and send them to hr@ibtekarmind.com , with a copy (CC) to Ibtekarmind2026@gmail.com . The application deadline is 20-November-2026, so ensure your submission is sent before this date.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview and a demo session. We look forward to receiving your applications .

title: Communication & Customer Relations Officer
salary: As per Zaviyar Trading Company Salary Scale
description:
Job Summary
Purpose of the Role
The Communication & Customer Relations Officer will serve as one of the primary communication representatives of Zaviyar Trading Company.
The officer will be responsible for handling incoming and outgoing telephone calls, WhatsApp messages, customer inquiries, supplier communications, and business-related correspondence.
The position requires a person with excellent communication skills, a pleasant and persuasive speaking style, a polite attitude, and the ability to convince customers professionally.
The officer will communicate with retailers, wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers, suppliers, and potential business partners to introduce Zaviyar's services and products, generate customer interest, follow up on inquiries, and support sales activities.
The officer must ensure that every customer receives a professional, friendly, respectful, and timely response, helping Zaviyar build trust and long-term business relationships.
Key Responsibilities & Duties
A. Telephone Communication & Call Handling
· Handle incoming and outgoing company telephone calls professionally.
· Respond to customer calls with a polite, friendly, and confident speaking style.
· Introduce Zaviyar Trading Company and explain its business services.
· Communicate with retailers, wholesalers, distributors, and potential customers.
· Make follow-up calls to customers who have shown interest in Zaviyar's products or services.
· Contact potential customers to introduce new products and business opportunities.
· Explain product availability, prices, offers, and delivery arrangements based on approved company information.
· Transfer technical, financial, or operational inquiries to the relevant department.
· Maintain records of important calls, customer requests, and follow-up requirements.
B. WhatsApp & Digital Customer Communication
· Manage the company's official WhatsApp Business account.
· Respond to customer messages promptly and professionally.
· Answer questions about products, prices, availability, orders, and delivery.
· Share approved product catalogues, pictures, price lists, promotional materials, and company information.
· Follow up with customers who have requested information or product quotations.
· Communicate new product introductions and approved promotional offers.
· Maintain organized customer conversations and follow-up records.
· Ensure that no customer inquiry remains unanswered without proper follow-up.
· Escalate complaints and complicated issues to the responsible department.
C. Customer Relationship Management
· Build and maintain positive relationships with retailers, wholesalers, distributors, and other customers.
· Welcome new customers and explain how to purchase products through Zaviyar.
· Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable products from the company's available catalogue.
· Maintain a professional and respectful relationship with existing customers.
· Follow up on customer satisfaction after orders and deliveries.
· Collect customer feedback, suggestions, and complaints.
· Maintain updated customer contact details and communication histories.
· Identify customers who may have potential for regular or bulk purchases.
D. Sales Communication & Customer Conversion
· Use persuasive, professional, and customer-friendly communication to generate interest in Zaviyar's products and services.
· Introduce new products to potential customers through calls and WhatsApp.
· Explain product benefits, approved prices, quality information, and purchasing arrangements.
· Encourage interested customers to place orders.
· Follow up on quotations, pending orders, and customers who have not completed their purchases.
· Identify sales opportunities and refer qualified leads to the Sales Manager or Order Booker team.
· Support sales campaigns and new product launches.
· Maintain records of interested customers, converted customers, and unsuccessful sales inquiries.
· Work toward assigned communication and sales-support targets.
E. Customer Orders & Coordination
· Receive customer order inquiries through telephone and WhatsApp.
· Record customer requirements accurately and forward orders to the relevant sales or order-processing team.
· Confirm that customers receive proper information about order status and delivery arrangements.
· Coordinate with Order Bookers, Sales Representatives, Warehouse, and Logistics teams.
· Follow up on pending orders, delivery delays, and customer requests.
· Inform customers about order updates using verified information from the relevant department.
· Never independently promise unapproved discounts, credit, delivery dates, or special arrangements.
F. Complaint Handling & Customer Support
· Receive and record customer complaints professionally.
· Listen carefully and respond calmly, respectfully, and helpfully.
· Coordinate with the relevant department to resolve customer issues.
· Follow up until the customer receives an appropriate response.
· Maintain a complaint register showing the issue, date, responsible department, and resolution status.
· Inform management about repeated complaints and common customer concerns.
· Protect customer information and maintain confidentiality.
G. Internal Communication & Reporting
· Coordinate with Sales, Finance, Procurement, Warehouse, Logistics, and Management.
· Share customer inquiries and important feedback with the appropriate departments.
· Maintain daily records of calls, WhatsApp messages, inquiries, leads, and follow-ups.
· Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly communication reports.
· Maintain an organized customer contact database.
· Ensure that company communication is consistent, accurate, and professional.
H. Delegated Responsibilities
· Perform other relevant duties assigned by the line manager in accordance with the position's responsibilities and company requirements.
Work Environment & Conditions
A. Office Setup
The officer will work at Zaviyar Trading Company's head office in Kabul, using company communication facilities, telephone services, WhatsApp Business, and customer management systems.
B. Working Hours
Saturday to Thursday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, subject to company policy and applicable labor requirements.
C. Coordination
The officer will report to the designated line manager and work closely with the Sales and Customer Relations teams.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance will be assessed based on:
· Number of incoming and outgoing calls handled.
· Response time to WhatsApp and other customer inquiries.
· Quality and professionalism of communication.
· Number of potential customers contacted.
· Number of qualified sales leads generated.
· Number of customers successfully converted into buyers.
· Accuracy of customer records and follow-up information.
· Customer satisfaction and complaint-handling performance.
· Timely follow-up on pending inquiries and orders.
· Achievement of assigned communication and sales-support targets.

Job Requirements
Required Qualifications
A. Academic Qualification
· Bachelor's degree in Communications, Business Administration, Marketing, Public Relations, or a related field is preferred.
· Candidates with strong communication skills and relevant practical experience may also be considered.
B. Professional Training
Training or certifications in the following areas are an advantage:
· Customer Service.
· Sales and Marketing.
· Business Communication.
· Call Center Operations.
· Customer Relationship Management (CRM).
· Digital Communication and WhatsApp Business.
C. Language Proficiency
· Excellent spoken Pashto and Dari.
· Good working knowledge of English is an advantage.
· Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with different types of customers.
· Strong writing skills for WhatsApp messages, business correspondence, and customer responses.
6. Professional Experience
· Minimum 3 years of experience in customer service, sales communication, call center operations, public relations, or client relationship management.
· Experience handling telephone calls and WhatsApp Business communication is strongly preferred.
· Experience in FMCG, trading, wholesale, retail, distribution, or commercial businesses is an advantage.
· Previous experience in customer conversion, telesales, or sales support is highly desirable.
Core Skills & Competencies
A. Excellent Verbal Communication
Must have a pleasant, clear, polite, confident, and professional speaking style.
B. Persuasion & Sales Convincing Skills
Must be able to explain products and services convincingly, understand customer needs, build interest, and encourage customers to make purchasing decisions without using pressure or misleading claims.
C. Customer-Friendly Attitude
Must be patient, respectful, helpful, and capable of dealing professionally with different personalities.
D. Telephone & WhatsApp Skills
Must be comfortable handling multiple calls and messages, following up with customers, and maintaining organized communication records.
E. Writing Skills
Must be able to write clear, polite, professional, and grammatically correct messages in Pashto and Dari.
F. Computer & Software Skills
· Microsoft Word and Excel.
· WhatsApp Business.
· Email and digital communication platforms.
· CRM or customer management software is an advantage.
G. Time Management & Responsibility
Must respond to customer inquiries on time, maintain follow-up schedules, and meet assigned communication targets.

Submission Guideline
Application Instructions
Interested candidates should submit:
1. Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV).
2. Cover Letter explaining their suitability for the position.
3. Copy of valid Afghan National ID (Tazkira).
4. Relevant work experience certificates.
5. Copies of educational and professional certificates.
Submission Details
· Email: info@zaviyartrading.com
Note: Please mention the vacancy number and position title in the email subject line.
· Office Address: Mandawi Road, Jabal Noor Market, 6th Floor, Office No. F27, Kabul, Afghanistan

title: Full-Stack Developer (Laravel, Flutter & React/Next.js)
category: Web Design, Web Application Development, Web Development
description:
Role Summary
Company: Asantya
Position: Full-Stack Web & Mobile Application Developer
Category: Information Technology / Software Development
Employment: Full-Time
Location: Khushal Khan, Kabul
Experience: 3+ years preferred
Vacancies: 1
Salary: Negotiable, based on qualifications and experience
Deadline: November 20, 2026
Apply via: job@sahiltracking.com
Asantya is a growing eCommerce and multi-vendor marketplace connecting customers, vendors, and delivery partners through digital solutions. We are hiring a developer to build, customize, maintain, and improve our website, mobile applications, vendor systems, and administration dashboard. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Laravel, Flutter, React.js/Next.js, REST APIs, MySQL, and complex marketplace platforms.

Duties and Responsibilities
Develop, maintain, customize, and enhance the eCommerce platform and existing source code.
Build and maintain Laravel backend services, REST APIs, admin dashboards, and vendor panels.
Develop and improve Flutter apps for customers, vendors, and delivery personnel on Android and iOS.
Build, maintain, and optimize the React.js/Next.js eCommerce website and responsive interfaces.
Implement new features and business requirements without disrupting existing functionality or data.
Integrate web/mobile applications with backend APIs, databases, and third-party services.
Improve product catalogs, categories, carts, checkout, orders, vendor operations, and delivery workflows.
Integrate payment gateways, cash-on-delivery workflows, SMS, email, Firebase, and Google Maps APIs.
Troubleshoot application bugs, server errors, deployment issues, and performance bottlenecks.
Optimize web and mobile speed, MySQL queries, API response times, and overall reliability.
Manage database migrations, backups, restores, and data integrity.
Deploy and maintain applications on Linux VPS servers using Apache or Nginx; manage SSL, domains, and DNS.
Prepare, sign, publish, and update Android and iOS apps via Google Play Console and Apple App Store Connect.
Use Git and GitHub/GitLab to maintain source code and support safe deployments.
Implement secure authentication, authorization, role-based access control, API security, and data protection.
Support English, Dari, and Pashto localization, including right-to-left (RTL) interfaces.
Test and verify changes before production release; safely apply updates while preserving customizations.
Maintain technical documentation, collaborate with management, prioritize tasks, and provide ongoing support.

Job Requirements
Required Technical Skills
Backend: Strong PHP/Laravel skills (routing, controllers, middleware, Eloquent ORM, migrations, queues, scheduled tasks); RESTful APIs, authentication, validation, authorization, security, and MySQL database design.
Mobile: Dart and Flutter development/maintenance for Android and iOS; state management (GetX, Provider, or Bloc); REST APIs, Firebase Cloud Messaging, Google Maps, debugging, signing, builds, and publishing.
Frontend: JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, React.js/Next.js, responsive UI, REST API integration, performance optimization, SEO fundamentals, and accessibility.
Servers & databases: Linux VPS (preferably Ubuntu), Apache/Nginx, SSL, domains/DNS, Composer, Node.js, npm/Yarn, deployment, MySQL optimization, backups/recovery, and logs.
Tools: Git/GitHub/GitLab, Visual Studio Code, Android Studio, Postman or equivalent, Flutter SDK, Composer, testing and debugging workflows.
Education, Experience & Competencies
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related field; equivalent practical experience is accepted.
3+ years of relevant software development experience preferred, including proven Laravel backend work, practical Flutter development, and React.js or Next.js.
Understanding of eCommerce and multi-vendor marketplace systems; ability to work with, modify, and maintain existing production code.
Strong analytical thinking, debugging, problem-solving, attention to detail, secure coding, and commitment to reliability and code quality.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively, communicate clearly, document technical work, manage deadlines, and learn new technologies.
Preferred Experience
Multi-vendor eCommerce projects and customer, vendor, and delivery management applications.
GPS tracking, maps, location-based delivery, online payments, and cash-on-delivery integrations.
Firebase, push notifications, real-time features, multilingual/RTL applications, and high-traffic deployments.
Safely updating, customizing, and maintaining live production systems.
Application Requirements & How to Apply
Send your updated CV/resume, project portfolio, GitHub/GitLab profile (if available), links to websites or published apps, a brief summary of your Laravel/Flutter/React/Next.js experience, relevant eCommerce or multi-vendor work, expected monthly salary, and earliest available start date.
Email: job@sahiltracking.com Subject: Application for Full-Stack Developer – Asantya
Application Deadline: November 20, 2026
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further assessment and interviews.
Join Asantya and help build a smarter, faster, and more reliable digital shopping experience!

Submission Guidelines
Interested and qualified candidates are invited to apply for the position of Full-Stack Web & Mobile Application Developer at Asantya.
Applicants must submit the following documents and information:
Updated CV/Resume: Highlight your educational background, technical skills, and relevant work experience.
Portfolio: Provide examples of completed web and mobile application development projects.
GitHub/GitLab Profile: Include a link to your code repositories, if available.
Project Links: Share links to websites or published Android/iOS applications you have developed or maintained.
Technical Experience: Briefly describe your practical experience with Laravel, Flutter, React.js/Next.js, MySQL, and REST APIs.
eCommerce Experience: Mention any previous involvement in eCommerce or multi-vendor marketplace projects.
Salary & Availability: Specify your expected monthly salary and earliest possible starting date.
How to Apply
Send your application and supporting documents to:
Email: job@sahiltracking.com
Email Subject: Application for Full-Stack Developer – Asantya
Application Deadline: November 20, 2026
Important Notes:
Applications must be submitted before the deadline.
Candidates should clearly demonstrate relevant technical skills and practical experience.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further assessment and interviews.
Incomplete applications may not be considered.
We encourage qualified and motivated developers to join Asantya and contribute to building innovative eCommerce solutions in Afghanistan.

title: Data Clerk
description:
Job Summary
Purpose of the Post:
To ensure accurate collection and management of Polio Eradication Initiative (PEI & EPI) data in the province
Organizational context :

title: Senior Farsi Linguistic QA Tester (Remote) - Mac M-Series Required
description:
Acclaro combines cultural and language expertise with AI technology to help brands grow their global presence, connect with customers, and mean something to them. As a trusted partner to some of the world’s biggest brands and fastest-growing global companies, our mission is to harness the powerful combination of human expertise and cutting-edge technology. We focus on putting brands into the heads, hearts, and hands of people everywhere. Our AI-powered business management and language platform ensures a faster time to market with measurable results, while our global team of language, country, and technology experts crafts localization strategies that empower our customers to succeed in any market.
Are you an experienced localization professional or linguistic QA specialist?
We are seeking seasoned Farsi Linguistic Testers with a background in software localization and IT terminology to join our global linguistic community. In this role, you will perform linguistic QA on cutting-edge software applications and AI models for the Farsi market. If you bring strong LQA experience, deep cultural expertise, and own an M-Series Mac, we want to partner with you.
Position Overview
Language Pair : English to Farsi
Domain : Information Technology (IT), AI Models & Software Localization
Experience Level : Experienced (2+ years in Linguistic QA or Linguistic Testing)
Hardware Requirement : Must own a Mac device with an M-series chip (M1, M2, M3, M4, or newer). Note: This is an absolute technical requirement for our secure testing environment.
Employment type: Freelance / Independent contractor
Responsibilities
As a Senior Farsi Linguistic Tester , you will:
Execute Linguistic QA: Conduct rigorous linguistic, stylistic, and functional testing on localized Farsi software interfaces and AI-generated content.
Bug Tracking & Reporting: Identify, log, and regress linguistic errors, visual layout glitches (e.g. truncations, rendering/font issues, alignment), and functional defects using standard issue-tracking workflows.
Terminology & Style Guide Enforcement: Ensure absolute adherence to project glossaries, style guides, and brand-specific localization standards.
Contextual & Cultural Validation: Verify that localized content is culturally appropriate, idiomatically precise, and tailored for the Farsi market.
Collaborate with Lead Engineers: Provide constructive feedback and linguistic solutions to remote localization managers and QA leads in clear English.
To qualify for this position, candidates must meet the following criteria:
Professional Experience: Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience in Linguistic QA, software localization testing, proofreading, or professional translation (English into Farsi).
Linguistic Proficiency: Native fluency in Farsi with exceptional command of grammar, typography, and orthography, paired with professional-level written English skills.
Hardware Specification (Mandatory): Active access to a Mac computer equipped with an Apple Silicon M-series chip (M1, M2, M3, M4, or newer).
LQA Methodology: Proven ability to differentiate between critical linguistic bugs, cosmetic layout defects, and preferential stylistic changes.
Cultural Competency: A strong, intuitive grasp of modern Farsi cultural nuances, localized language trends, and regional idiomatic expressions.
Technical Aptitude: Comfort navigating new software interfaces, adhering to detailed testing guidelines, and reporting technical/linguistic bugs clearly in English.
Work Environment: A reliable high-speed internet connection and a dedicated workspace suitable for remote, independent contract work.
Attention to Quality: Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to consistently identify minor grammatical, formatting, and user-interface (UI) errors.
Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere, managing your own hours around project deadlines.

description:
Role Summary
هدف وظیفه: مدیریت، نظارت و اجرای امور تخنیکی مربوطه به ثبت، درج، تنظیم، و نگهداری معلومات وسایط نقلیه در سیستم معلوماتی، بمنظور تامین دقت، شفافیت، صحت و دسترسی به موقع به معلومات وسایط همچنان بررسی اسناد و مشخصات تخنیکی وسایط، جلوگیری از ثبت معلومات تکراری یا نادرست جهت بهبود روند ثبت و مدیریت معلومات وسایط.

Duties and Responsibilities
وظایف و مسؤلیتها:
وظایف اساسی:
ثبت و درج معلومات و ارقام مربوط به فعالیت‌های اداره در سیستم معلوماتی و دیتابیس مربوطه.
ث جمع‌آوری معلومات از منابع مشخص و بررسی ابتدایی صحت و تکمیل بودن آن‌ها قبل از ثبت.
وارد نمودن معلومات به‌صورت دقیق، منظم و به‌موقع در سیستم.
بررسی و تصحیح اشتباهات موجود در معلومات ثبت‌شده، مطابق اسناد و منابع معتبر.
به‌روزرسانی منظم معلومات و حفظ سوابق تغییرات در سیستم.
تنظیم، طبقه‌بندی و نگهداری اسناد و معلومات ثبت‌شده به شکل فزیکی و الکترونیکی.
تهیه گزارش‌های روزانه، هفتگی، ماهانه و سایر گزارش‌های مورد نیاز از معلومات ثبت‌شده.
همکاری در استخراج، تحلیل ابتدایی و ارائه ارقام و معلومات مورد نیاز مسؤولین.
ایجاد و تنظیم فایل‌های الکترونیکی و بانک‌های معلوماتی مربوط به ریاست ع شرطه مرور.
بررسی تکراری نبودن معلومات و جلوگیری از ثبت اشتباه یا چندباره معلومات وسایط.
حفظ محرمیت معلومات و جلوگیری از دسترسی اشخاص غیرمجاز به اسناد و دیتابیس.
تهیه نسخه‌های احتیاطی (Backup) از معلومات، در صورت موجودیت سیستم و صلاحیت لازم.
همکاری تخنیکی با کارمندان مربوط در زمینه ثبت، تنظیم و مدیریت معلومات.
گزارش‌دهی به موقع مشکلات تخنیکی، کمبود معلومات، نواقص اسناد و سایر موارد مرتبط به مسؤول مربوطه.
رعایت طرزالعمل‌ها، مقررات اداری و اصول استفاده مصئون از سیستم‌های معلوماتی.
وظایف مدیریتی و هماهنگی:
تهیه و ترتیب پلان کاری، گزارش کاری ماهانه، ربعوار، سالانه عندالموقع در مطابقت با پلان وزارت امور داخله
اتنقال مهارت های مسلکی به شیوه تدویر ورکشاپ ها، سیمینارها و آموزش های مرتبط وظیفوی به نیرو های پولیس ملی
تامین ارتباط و هماهنگی با بخش های مختلف وزارت امور داخله جهت تحقق اهداف استراتیژیک وزارت
ارائیه گزارش ماهانه، ربعوار وسالانه عندالضرورت از فعالیت های ودست آورد های مربوط به آمر مافوق.

Job Requirements
شرایط استخدام :
تابعیت افغانستان را داشته باشد.
سن وی از (18)سال کمتر و از (64) سال بیشتر نباشد.

داشتن سند تحصیلی حداقل لیسانس از رشته کمیپوتر ساینس داخل یا خارج کشور که به تائید وزارت تحصیلات عالی رسیده باشد.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop and Manage the Product Backlog :
Define and prioritize features, user stories, and tasks for the development team.
Ensure the product backlog is updated and transparent to the team.
Engage with Stakeholders :
Collaborate with customers, users, and stakeholders to gather product requirements.
Communicate effectively with the development team to ensure a clear understanding of business and technical needs.
Define Product Vision :
Establish and communicate the product's vision, goals, and strategy to the development team and stakeholders.
Align the product with market needs in collaboration with the Product Manager.
Make Decisions on Product Features and Functionality :
Decide which features to prioritize and which to de-prioritize.
Provide feedback to the development team on design and functionality.
Evaluate and Test the Product :

Ensure the final product meets the requirements and expectations of stakeholders.
Work with Agile/Scrum Teams :
Attend daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospective meetings.
Manage changes in priorities and adjust plans as needed.
Analyze Product Data and Performance :
Monitor KPIs and key product metrics to assess performance.
Use data to propose improvements and strategic changes.
Manage Stakeholder and Customer Expectations :
Ensure customer satisfaction by delivering a product that meets their needs and resolves their problems.
Provide regular updates on product progress and next steps.
Oversee Quality and Product Releases :
Ensure the product is release-ready and meets quality standards.
Monitor release timelines and deliver new features on schedule.
Manage Product Risks :
Identify and manage risks related to product design, development, and releases.
IV. Impact of Results
The performance of the Product Owner has a direct impact on the success of product development and overall business growth. Effective execution of responsibilities ensures that product features align with user needs, stakeholder expectations, and market demands. Timely and well-prioritized product releases contribute to increased customer satisfaction, improved team productivity, and the company's competitive advantage. Failure to perform adequately in this role can lead to misaligned products, wasted development efforts, delayed releases, and diminished stakeholder trust.

Focuses on results for the client and responds positively to feedback;

presentation skills
Consistently approaches work with energy and a positive, constructive attitude; Demonstrates openness to change and ability to manage complexity.

Ability to establish good working relations with a range of stakeholders.
Ability to coach, mentor, and develop people skills.
Ability to focus on results

Ramaki Group of Companies is seeking a qualified Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to define and execute the technology vision, strategy, and roadmap for its digital products and platforms. The CTO will own the end-to-end technology function for Ramaki's fintech operations, from strategic planning and team development to vendor management and system reliability. • Define the technology vision, strategy, and roadmap in line with business goals.

• Oversee the security approach and make sure security is built into the platform.

title: IT Database Administrator
description:
Role Summary
This role responsible for administering, maintaining, and securing Oracle database environments to ensure high availability, optimal performance, and reliability. Key responsibilities include database administration, PL/SQL development, performance tuning, backup and recovery, security management, and implementing HA/DR solutions using RMAN, RAC, ASM, and Data Guard, while ensuring efficient operations and 24/7 technical support.

Duties and Responsibilities
Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and maintain Oracle Database software and related components.
Manage, administer, and monitor Oracle databases to ensure high availability, security, reliability, and optimal performance.
Build and maintain new databases and development, testing, UAT, and production environments.
Develop and maintain PL/SQL procedures, functions, packages, and triggers, and perform SQL and database performance tuning.
Design, implement, and maintain database architecture, structures, and schemas.
Design and manage database backup and recovery solutions using Oracle RMAN.
Implement and maintain Oracle High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions, including RAC, ASM, and Data Guard.
Perform database space management, partitioning, capacity planning, replication, and recovery operations.
Implement, maintain database security, access controls, auditing, and compliance requirements.
Automate database administration and maintenance tasks using shell scripting and Oracle tools.
Perform database migrations, patch management, version control, upgrades, and production schema changes.
Diagnose, resolve database performance, connectivity, availability, infrastructure-related issues.
Monitor database capacity, resource utilization, performance to ensure optimal efficiency and scalability.
Maintain database documentation, technical standards, operational procedures, and performance reports.
Evaluate Oracle technology, product to improve database infrastructure and operational efficiency.
Work closely with the Head of Section, infrastructure teams, database programmers, and application developers.
Coordinate with Oracle Corporation, relevant vendors for technical support and issue resolution.
Provide technical guidance and training to team members and participate in on-call duties to ensure 24/7 database support when required.
Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor.
Familiarity with Linux and Oracle Solaris operating systems, including system administration, command-line operations, shell scripting, and troubleshooting.

Job Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum of five (5) years of professional experience in database administration, preferably with enterprise-level Oracle Database environments.
Oracle Certified Associate (OCA) certification and Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) certification would be a plus point.
Strong knowledge and practical experience with Oracle Grid Infrastructure, Automatic Storage Management (ASM), and Real Application Clusters (RAC).
Strong knowledge of Oracle Data Guard, RMAN, backup and recovery, and high availability technologies.
Solid understanding of Oracle database architecture, internals, and performance tuning.
Experience with Oracle database installation, patching, upgrades, and migrations.
SQL and PL/SQL Development, Database Design, and Performance Tuning.
Database Security, Auditing, Capacity Planning, and Space Management.
Database Automation and Shell Scripting (Bash/Korn Shell).
Database Replication, Migration, Monitoring, and Troubleshooting.

Submission Guidelines
If you meet the above requirements, we are encouraging you to apply for this position. Please send us your CV along with a cover letter via email ( vacancies@fmfb.com.af ).
Please make sure that your email includes the vacancy ID as the subject line.

title: کارشناس ارشد مدیریت سیستم های معلوماتی
description:
Role Summary
هدف وظیفه : تحلیل، طراحی، توسعه و بهبود سیستم‌های معلوماتی به ‌منظور افزایش کارایی، شفافیت و دقت در پروسه‌های اداری و حمایت از تصمیم‌ گیری مؤثر در اداره.

Duties and Responsibilities
وظایف و مسئولیت ها:
وظایف اساسی:
· طراحی معماری سیستم‌ها (System Architecture)، تهیه نمودارها (Flow chart, UML, DFD) و طراحی ساختار دیتابیس و جریان معلومات.
· تحلیل نیازمندی‌های بخش‌های مختلف اداره، شناسایی مشکلات و ارائه راه ‌حل‌های سیستمی ریاست عمومی انسجام امور شاروالی ها.
· مستند سازی پروسه‌های کاری (To-Be, As-is) در ریاست عمومی انسجام امورشاروالی ها.
· نظارت بر انکشاف نرم ‌افزارها، همکاری با پروگرامرها و تیم تخنیکی و تست، ارزیابی و رفع نواقص سیستم‌ها.
· پلان‌گذاری پروژه‌های سیستم‌ سازی، تعیین زمان‌ بندی (Timeline) و منابع و نظارت بر تطبیق و پیشرفت پروژه‌ها.
· بلدیت به زبان های پروگرام نویسی Back-End و Front-End مانند (Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, PHP, C#).
· بلدیت با برنامه های Oracle، MySQL، SQL Server جهت ایجاد دیتابس و سیستم ها.
· تست و رفع نواقص سیستم‌ها (Debugging) در ریاست عمومی انسجام امور شاروالی ها.
· انتقال معلومات (Data Migration)از سیستم های قبلی به سیستم جدید.
· نظارت بر طراحی و نگهداری دیتابیس‌ها، تضمین صحت، امنیت و یکپارچگی معلومات، تهیه راپورهای تحلیلی برای مدیریت.
· هماهنگی با آمریت سیستم‌های دیجیتلی و سایر بخش‌ها، ارتباط با شرکت‌های قراردادی و مشاورین، ارائه مشوره تخنیکی به مدیریت.
· تهیه اسناد تخنیکی و کاربری سیستم ‌ها، نگهداری مستندات برای توسعه‌های آینده و تهیه رهنمودها و طرزالعمل‌ها برای سیستم ها.
· انجام تست‌های مختلف (functional, Performance) و اطمینان از مطابقت سیستم با نیازمندی‌ها و نظارت بر کیفیت توسعه سیستم ها.
· آموزش کارمندان در استفاده از سیستم‌های جدید، پاسخگویی به مشکلات مربوط به سیستم‌های انکشافی.
· اشتراک در جلسات تخنیکی و اداری ، پیگیری تکنالوژی‌های جدید و پیشنهاد نوآوری،
وظایف مدیریتی:
· ترتیب پلان کاری ماهوار، ربعوار و سالانه آمریت مربوطه در مطابقت با پلان عمومی ریاست، بمنظور رسیدن به اهداف تعیین شده.
· مدیریت، ارزیابی اجراات، تعیین نیاز های آموزشی و ارتقای ظرفیت کارکنان بخش های تحت اثر.
· ارائه گزارش ماهوار، ربعوار، سالانه و عندالضرورت از فعالیت ها و دست آورد های بخش مربوطه.
· اجرای سایر وظایف که از طرف آمر ذیصلاح مطابق قوانین، مقررات و اهداف اداره مربوطه سپرده میشود.
وظایف هماهنگی:

title: Senior Project Associate (DTM/Database)
description:

Coordinate the development, implementation and administration of database information systems to gather and process information required for DTM implementation, using industry standard design principles and patterns to attain high re-usability and maintainability.
Support the reporting and analysis of data by creating database structures and views for end user interfaces.
Verify the information and accuracy of the data in the system and monitor that figures entered into the system are the same as captured on the forms during the field assessments, by supporting the automation of data validation mechanisms. Communicate results to the DTM Team Leaders and coordinate with the Data Entry Clerks to solve the identified issues.
Coordinate the design and revision of the tools and the development of forms using KOBO Toolbox.
Design and deploy applications specifically tailored to enhance data collection, processing, and reporting capabilities within DTM. Collaborate closely with HQ ICT to address server-related issues, ensuring efficient application deployment and optimal use of storage space across various units in the organization.
Support developing and implementing proper backup, restore, data validation, and security procedures to ensure data integrity and availability
Support in creating comprehensive documentation and technical reports that clearly outline development processes, system architectures, and data flow. Verify all documentation is accurate, up-to-date, and effectively supports the understanding and replication of technological solutions.
Visit field offices to provide supportive supervision and training of data entry by Enumerators to ensure the quality of data entered into IOM databases.
Ensure adherence to data protection policies following procedures put in place for requests for data changes, access and general database use.
Other tasks assigned by the line manager.
Required Qualifications and Experience
Education
· Bachelor’s degree, equivalent or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related course with four years of relevant experience in data/information management, preferably in crisis and humanitarian situations.
Or
· High School diploma with six years of relevant experience in data/information management, preferably in crisis and humanitarian situations.

description:

Danger Pay Residential location (if applicable) Target Start Date 2026-12-01 Target End Date 2027-11-29 Standard Job Description Information Management Officer Organizational Setting and Work Relationships The UNHCR Data Transformation Strategy 2020-2025 envisions that by 2025 UNHCR becomes a trusted leader on data and information related to refugees and other forcibly displaced and stateless persons, thereby enabling actions to protect and to empower forcibly displaced and stateless persons. The Strategy stipulates investing in four complementary priority areas: data management and governance; information systems; capacities and skill development; and culture for evidence-informed decision-making. The strategy envisages data and information management functions in UNHCR carried out in a complementary and inter-linked manner between Headquarters Divisions and Services, Regional Bureaux, Country Operations and key external partners, includingforcibly displaced and stateless persons. Under the direct supervision of the (Snr) DIMA Coordinator/Deputy Director/Head of Service/Representative/Senior IMO or other designated manager, the Information Management Officer is responsible for coordinating and supporting data and information management activities in the relevant offices, as well as supporting and overseeing data and information management activities in the relevant country and regional offices. They are either part of or responsible for leading and motivating a team of data and information management staff in the regional office (depending on regional office configuration); to ensure coordination among staff working on information and data management activities in the regional office; and to function as the liaison with Headquarters on data related issues. Information and data management staff are responsible for coordinating, planning and delivering on data and information activities for all UNHCR operational contexts, responses and populations of concern, including providing coordination and leadership in partnerships on data with all stakeholders - including forcibly displaced and stateless persons. They serve the entirety of UNHCR staff and activities, including protection, programme, operations, external relations and executive management for evidence-informed planning, advocacy, and coordination. They are key in ensuring multi-stakeholder, multi-sector, and multi-country activities are provided with robust and meaningful data and information to support planning, funding and advocacy efforts. This includes both internal and external assessments, regional and country-based planning and monitoring activities such as the COPs, CRRF, RRPs, HNOs, HRPs, and Cluster Plans. Information and data management covers the assessment, design, implementation and evaluation of data and statistical related activities. This includes assessment of the information landscape; definition of information and data needs; design of data and information activities, including data collection, analysis, storage and dissemination; implementation of data and information management activities; and monitoring and evaluation of data management activities. The focus is largely operational and protection data along with financial and HR data related to assessment, planning, monitoring and evaluation. This is the data, information and analysis needed to deliver robust and comprehensive assessments and evaluations, and to support results-based planning, monitoring and reporting implemented by UNHCR and by its partners. Depending on if they are located in HQ, regional or country offices, the role of the data and information management staff is to provide the necessary quality assurance and technical support for the full range of the data and information management and analysis activities to countries and regional offices; to ensure these process are in accordance with technical standards for data and information management; and to undertake regional or country data and information management (definition, collection, analysis, storage and dissemination) activities. In addition they are responsible for coordinating HQ and external support to the country and regional offices, to liaise with relevant bodies on relevant data and statistical matters; to monitor the quality of data and information management activities in country/regional or HQ; to design and implement global, regional or country-based data strategies and systems; to ensure data and information activities are implemented in accordance with data privacy policies, global data sharing agreements and data protection regulations; to communicate the status, value and importance of data; to provide the data, information and analysis needed for global analysis; and to identify risks and opportunities based on insights derived from data. All UNHCR staff members are accountable to perform their duties as reflected in their job description. They do so within their delegated authorities, in line with the regulatory framework of UNHCR which includes the UN Charter, UN Staff Regulations and Rules, UNHCR Policies and Administrative Instructions as well as relevant accountability frameworks. In addition, staff members are required to discharge their responsibilities in a manner consistent with the core, functional, cross-functional and managerial competencies and UNHCR's core values of professionalism, integrity and respect for diversity. Duties Coordinate data and information management activities at the Country /Regional/Global level: - Participate in the relevant data and information management team and activities. - Contribute to the design and implement data strategies and systems. - Assist the data team and others communicate the status, value, and importance of data. - Support the collection, storage, management and protection of data in the region/country or at the global level. - Support consolidation of data systems, including the interoperability of operational data and systems. - Ensure consistency of data and results for country, global and regional analysis, including cross border analysis and response. - Identify risks and opportunities based on insights derived from data. - Support the coordination with HQ, external and internal partners on data and information management efforts and mechanisms, including OCHA, IOM, regional economic commissions and other institutions with statistical or data interests, UNICEF, and WFP. - Lead or take part the relevant IM networks (internal and external) on refugee, IDP, stateless and related issues. - Improve data quality in the region/county or globally through field support, capacity building, monitoring and feedback. - Support data security, data protection and responsible data-sharing. Support offices with data and information management support (if Global or Regional): - Provide technical guidance on methodologies, and support for data management activities such as surveys, secondary data reviews, targeting and vulnerability assessments, indicator definition, population estimation, profiling, statistical analysis, predictive analytics, big data, international recommendations, GIS, data visualisation, maps, official statistics and other data and information management activities. - Support the analysis of primary and secondary data for interpretation and evidence-informed decision making. - Support the monitoring of data and information management activities in the relevant offices for integrity, veracity, reliability and credibility and compliance with policies. - Document needs and capacities for data management activities. - Provide technical and training support to operations. - Support assessments and situational analysis process with analytical frameworks, data collection, and analysis (standards, methodologies). - Support planning process (standards, methodologies) quality assurance and technical advice on Theories of Change and indicators, as well as with data and statistical analysis - Support monitoring by providing quality assurance and technical advice to the monitoring methodologies, data collection and analysis. - Review and assess country or region-specific data systems and needs; provide recommendations for solutions. - Undertake data and information management activities: - Lead and undertake data management activities (definition of needs, data collection, analysis, storage and dissemination) - Lead and undertake geospatial analysis, statistical analysis, targeting, surveys, indicator definition and other data management activities. - Consolidate data and information for analysis. - Support analysis for comparative country, regional and global analysis, including political and socio-economic trends. - Take part in planning processes (COPs, regional RRP, regional migration response plans, etc.). - Support cross-country assessment and situational analysis, such as in regional RRP situation. - Undertake the analysis of trends concerning changes at the outcome and impact levels. - Develop information management products such as indicators, templates, maps and dashboards. - Help ensure data is curated and stored in data registries and libraries in accordance with standards. - Provide population movement tracking systems and other population data systems - Support solutions for meeting 'communication with communities' information and data needs. Work in close collaboration with: - All staff to further data literacy and assist in interpretation the data. - Registration staff regarding the use of individual and personally identifiable data collected or managed by UNHCR. - Programme staff on the data and information aspects of assessment, targeting and monitoring (three most data driven aspects of the OMC). - Cluster coordinators and partners on data and information needs in UNHCR-led cluster operations, including HNO and HRP processes. - Inter-agency staff on the development, coordination and monitoring of responses plans. - Protection staff on the design, implementation and analysis of protection and case monitoring systems. - Operations coordinators and reporting officers on the design and delivery of data and information management products for internal and external consumption. - Sectors technical experts on the methodologies, formats, storage and dissemination of sectoral data and information, including cross sector analysis. - Senior management to understand and serve their information and knowledge needs. - Support the identification and management of risks and seek to seize opportunities impacting objectives in the area of responsibility. Raise risks, issues and concerns to a supervisor or to relevant functional colleague(s). - Perform other related duties as required. title: MEAL Officer
description:
Job Summary
Job Summary:
The MEAL Officer is responsible for supporting the design, implementation, and management of Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning systems to ensure quality programming, evidence-based decision-making, donor compliance, and continuous organizational learning. The position will ensure timely collection, analysis, reporting, and utilization of project data to improve program effectiveness and accountability to beneficiaries and stakeholders.
Duties and Responsibilities:
Develop and maintain project monitoring plans, indicator tracking tables, and data collection tools.
Monitor project implementation against approved work plans, log frames, and targets.
Conduct regular field visits to verify activities and assess progress.
Track project outputs, outcomes, and performance indicators.
Ensure timely and accurate collection of quantitative and qualitative data.
Support project teams in measuring achievements against established indicators.
Support the design and implementation of baseline, midline, end-line, and impact assessments.
Participate in needs assessments, surveys, and evaluations.
Coordinate data collection activities for internal and external evaluations.
Analyse evaluation findings and provide recommendations for program improvement.
Assist in preparing evaluation reports and disseminating results to stakeholders.
Develop and update project Performance Measurement Frameworks (PMFs).
Define project indicators, means of verification, targets, and reporting frequencies.
Track donor-specific and organizational indicators.
Verify indicator achievements through supporting documentation and evidence.
Maintain indicator databases and dashboards to monitor progress.
Establish and maintain data management systems and databases.
Verify data quality, accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability.
Conduct routine data cleaning and validation exercises.
Analyze project data and generate statistical summaries, charts, and dashboards.
Ensure proper data storage, confidentiality, and protection standards are maintained.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, annual, and donor-required MEAL reports.
Provide accurate data and analysis for programmatic and donor reporting.
Develop data visualizations and performance summaries for management decision-making.
Compile beneficiary statistics, achievements, lessons learned, and challenges.
Support preparation of presentations and project performance updates.
Establish and manage beneficiary feedback and complaint response mechanisms.
Ensure communities are aware of available accountability channels.
Record, track, and follow up on complaints, feedback, and suggestions.
Ensure confidential and timely handling of sensitive complaints.
Generate accountability reports and recommend corrective actions where necessary.
Document lessons learned, best practices, case studies, and success stories.
Facilitate reflection meetings, review workshops, and learning sessions.
Promote the use of MEAL findings to improve program quality and effectiveness.
Support the development of organizational knowledge products.
Share learning and evidence with project teams and management.
Train project staff and partners on MEAL tools, systems, and methodologies.
Build staff capacity in data collection, data quality, reporting, and indicator tracking.
Conduct routine Data Quality Assessments (DQAs).
Ensure compliance with organizational, donor, and sector-specific MEAL standards.
Provide technical support to project teams on monitoring and evaluation practices.
Support internal and external audits related to project performance and data quality.
Any other tasks assigned by the Supervisor.

Job Requirements
Education
Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Economics, Development Studies, Public Administration, Monitoring & Evaluation, or a related field.
A Master's Degree will be considered an advantage.
Experience
Minimum 4 years of relevant professional experience in MEAL, Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E), data management, research, or project performance monitoring within NGOs, INGOs and UN agencies.
Demonstrated experience in designing and managing monitoring systems, indicator tracking, evaluations, and data analysis.
Experience in donor-funded projects and reporting requirements.
Technical Skills
Strong knowledge of MEAL frameworks, logical frameworks (Log frames), and Results-Based Management (RBM).
Experience with data collection platforms such as Kobo Toolbox, ODK, MODA, Survey CTO, or similar tools.
Strong quantitative and qualitative data analysis skills.
Knowledge of Power BI, SPSS, STATA, or other analytical software is an advantage.
Organizational Responsibilities:
Notice to Applicants: Please be aware that as part of our commitment to ensuring the highest standards of professional conduct, all candidates applying for a position with our organization will be subject to comprehensive background and reference checks. This is to verify the accuracy of the information provided and assess suitability for the role. In addition, we place a strong emphasis on ethical behavior and integrity in our work environment. As such, adherence to our code of conduct forms an integral part of our annual performance appraisal process. We encourage all prospective applicants to bear this in mind when applying.
Policy Adherence
Adhere to the Code of Conduct, all applicable policies of the ASIO, maintain humanitarian principles and respect international humanitarian law.
Fraud prevention:
Committed to fraud prevention, detection, reporting and fraud risk reduction as per ASIO policies and procedures, donor regulations and local laws.
Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA):
The Afghanistan Social Improvement Organization (ASIO) strictly prohibits any form of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse by its staff towards the individuals they serve. Such actions are in direct violation of the universally recognized norms, values, principles, and standards that form the foundation of our organization. The responsibility of safeguarding against Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) lies with everyone, and all potential candidates must adhere to ASIO’s PSEA Policy without exception. Consequently, candidates under consideration will be subjected to thorough reference and background checks concerning any past incidents of sexual exploitation and abuse. They may also be asked to furnish additional information as part of the selection process.
Compliance & Ethics:
Promotes and encourages a culture of compliance and ethics throughout and within Afghanistan Social Improvement Organization “ASIO”. As applicable to the position, maintains a clear understanding of within Afghanistan Social Improvement Organization “ASIO” and donor compliance and ethics standards and adheres to those standards. Conducts tasks with the highest level of integrity.
Safeguarding:
It is all staff’s shared responsibility and obligation to safeguard and protect populations with whom we work, including adults who may be particularly vulnerable and children. We must ensure that our staff and partners do not engage in any conduct that could harm or exploit these individuals. This includes sexual exploitation and abuse, neglect or abuse of children and adults at risk, and any form of human trafficking.

Submission Guideline
Interested applicants are invited to submit their Curriculum Vitae (CV) through the following link: https://hrms.asio.org.af/jobs/11
Please ensure that the position title and vacancy number are included in the subject line (e.g., MEAL Officer- ASIO26/0086 ), applications that do not follow this format will not be considered.
Only short-listed candidates will be contacted for a written test and/or interview. If you do not hear from us within two to three weeks after the closing date, please assume that your application was not successful.

title: Network Officer
description:
Role Summary
Insta Telecom is seeking a skilled and motivated Network Officer to join its Technical and Network Operations team in Kabul.
The Network Officer will be responsible for planning, deploying, configuring, monitoring, maintaining, and troubleshooting wireless Point-to-Point (PTP), Point-to-Multipoint (PTMP), and Fiber-to-the-Home (FTTH) network infrastructure.
The successful candidate will conduct technical site surveys, manage customer installations and service activations, maintain network reliability, troubleshoot connectivity issues, and coordinate with the NOC, Fiber, FTTH, and Engineering teams to ensure efficient network operations and high-quality internet services.
The position also involves supervising field technicians, preparing technical reports, supporting network expansion projects, and ensuring compliance with company technical standards and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

Duties and Responsibilities
Wireless Network Deployment (PTP/PTMP)
· Conduct technical site surveys for PTP and PTMP wireless network installations and prepare feasibility assessment reports.
· Plan, install, configure, align, test, and commission wireless links according to company standards.
· Perform wireless link performance testing, signal optimization, and connectivity verification.
· Manage customer installation activities from initial survey to final service activation.
· Support network expansion, customer migrations, and equipment upgrades.
Network Monitoring & Troubleshooting
· Monitor network performance, connectivity, signal quality, bandwidth utilization, and service stability.
· Diagnose and resolve wireless network faults, connectivity interruptions, and service degradation.
· Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on wireless radios, network equipment, and customer connections.
· Configure, troubleshoot, and maintain wireless devices and associated networking equipment.
· Ensure network availability, service reliability, and compliance with agreed SLAs.
FTTH & GPON Network Support
· Troubleshoot FTTH network connectivity and customer service issues.
· Diagnose and resolve GPON, OLT, ONT, and fiber-related faults.
· Coordinate with the Fiber and FTTH teams for service restoration and new customer activations.
· Support the installation, testing, and activation of FTTH customer connections.
Documentation & Reporting
· Prepare and maintain site survey reports, installation records, network diagrams, and maintenance documentation.
· Maintain accurate records of network configurations, customer installations, and technical changes.
· Prepare technical incident reports and provide regular updates on assigned activities.
Team Coordination & Supervision
· Coordinate with NOC, Fiber, FTTH, and Engineering teams to resolve technical issues and complete network deployments.
· Supervise and provide technical guidance to field technicians and junior network engineers.
· Support technical training and knowledge sharing among team members.
· Follow company policies, safety procedures, and technical standards.
· Perform other network-related duties assigned by the CTO or management.

Job Requirements
Education
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related field.
Relevant technical diplomas with strong practical experience may also be considered.
Professional Experience
Minimum 2–3 years of practical experience in ISP network operations, wireless network deployment, or telecommunications.
Hands-on experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting PTP and PTMP wireless networks.
Experience in customer premises equipment (CPE) installation and internet service activation.
Experience with FTTH/GPON networks is highly desirable.
Technical Skills
Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking, IP addressing, subnetting, VLANs, routing, and switching.
Practical experience with wireless networking technologies, including PTP and PTMP systems.
Familiarity with equipment from vendors such as Ubiquiti, MikroTik, and Cambium Networks.
Ability to perform wireless site surveys, antenna alignment, signal analysis, and link optimization.
Understanding of wireless frequency planning, interference, signal strength, and link capacity.
Knowledge of PPPoE, DHCP, DNS, NAT, and basic network troubleshooting.
Familiarity with GPON technologies, OLTs, ONTs, and FTTH infrastructure.
Ability to troubleshoot fiber connectivity and optical signal issues.
Knowledge of network monitoring tools and troubleshooting utilities.
Ability to prepare technical documentation and network diagrams.
Certifications (Preferred)
CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate).
MikroTik MTCNA or equivalent.

title: IT Officer – MIS System Support
category: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology
description:
Role Summary
The IT Officer – MIS System Support will be responsible for the day-to-day administration, maintenance, security, and operational support of the Aurum MFI MIS system. The successful candidate will serve as the dedicated technical focal point for the system, ensuring its availability, data integrity, proper user access management, timely backups, and effective coordination with relevant departments, software developers, and external technical support providers.

Duties and Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities
1. MIS System Administration
Manage and monitor the day-to-day operation of the Aurum MFI MIS system.
Create, configure, update, suspend, and deactivate user accounts based on authorized requests.
Assign and manage user roles and access permissions in accordance with approved policies.
Maintain system configurations, operational settings, and user access records.
Monitor system performance and report technical issues, errors, or operational disruptions.
2. Data Backup and Recovery
Perform and monitor regular backups of the MIS database and related system data.
Verify backup completion and periodically test data restoration procedures.
Maintain backup logs and ensure backups are stored securely in accordance with the approved backup policy.
Coordinate with the relevant technical team to resolve backup failures and support data recovery when required.
Help ensure data integrity, availability, and business continuity.
3. Technical Support and Troubleshooting
Provide first-level technical support to MIS users and resolve routine system-related issues.
Investigate system errors, access problems, data discrepancies, and performance issues.
Document incidents, follow up on unresolved issues, and escalate complex technical problems to the relevant developers or service providers.
Coordinate system troubleshooting, bug fixes, upgrades, patches, and technical improvements.
Support system testing and verification before changes are implemented in the production environment.
4. System Maintenance and Security
Coordinate routine system maintenance and monitor system availability.
Ensure that user access is properly authorized and reviewed periodically.
Follow approved information security, data protection, and access control procedures.
Maintain technical documentation, system configuration records, backup logs, and incident reports.
Identify potential operational and security risks and report them to the relevant team.
5. Technical and Departmental Coordination
Act as the primary IT focal point for MIS-related matters.
Coordinate with the Microfinance Operations team, Finance, relevant business units, software developers, and external technical support providers.
Follow up on reported issues, requested changes, system enhancements, and pending technical tasks.
Assist in gathering business requirements and communicating them to the technical team.
6. Reporting and User Support
Prepare periodic reports on system availability, incidents, backup status, user administration, and maintenance activities.
Maintain an updated record of users, permissions, technical issues, and system changes.
Guide and assist staff in using the MIS system correctly and securely.
Provide basic user training and prepare user guides or operational instructions when necessary.
Perform other relevant IT and MIS support duties assigned by the IT Manager.

Job Requirements
Qualifications and Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in IT support, MIS support or a similar position.
Experience supporting a Management Information System (MIS), preferably in microfinance, banking, financial services, or another regulated organization.
Understanding of user administration, role-based access control, system security, and data protection.
Familiarity with web-based applications, application troubleshooting, and software maintenance.
Good documentation, reporting, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.
Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and maintain confidentiality when handling financial and customer data.
Key Competencies
Technical troubleshooting and analytical thinking.
Accuracy and attention to detail.
Accountability and ownership of assigned responsibilities.
Effective communication and teamwork.
Confidentiality and professional integrity.
Proactive monitoring and timely reporting of technical issues.

Submission Guidelines
How to Apply:
Interested and qualified candidates are invited to submit their CV and cover letter (in PDF format) to jobs@aurumaf.com
Please mention the position title “ IT Officer – MIS System Support ” in the subject line of your email.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Job Summary
A. Backend Development & Microservices
· Design, develop, maintain, and optimize backend services and REST APIs using C# and ASP.NET Core / .NET Core.
· Design services using microservice architecture, clear service boundaries, maintainable domain/application layers, and clean architecture principles.
· Implement authentication, authorization, role/permission management, API validation, error handling, background processing, and secure service-to-service communication.
· Work with SQL Server and relational data access using Entity Framework Core; design efficient schemas, migrations, indexes, transactions, and queries.
· Implement distributed caching and cache invalidation strategies using Redis or equivalent technologies.
· Use RabbitMQ for asynchronous messaging, event-driven workflows, queues, retries, and reliable communication between services; implement real-time application features using appropriate technologies such as SignalR/WebSockets where required.
· Integrate MOAM systems with ERP (including Sage), CRM, payment gateways, SMS/notification services, Firebase, customs systems, and other internal or third-party platforms.
B. Frontend Development
· Develop and maintain responsive, secure, production-ready web applications using Next.js, React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
· Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs, authentication flows, real-time features, and server-side/client-side data fetching as appropriate.
· Build reusable UI components, handle application state effectively, and ensure performance, accessibility, maintainability, and cross-browser compatibility.
C. Mobile Application Development
· Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart.
· Integrate Flutter applications with .NET APIs and Firebase services such as Cloud Messaging/push notifications, authentication, analytics, or other required Firebase capabilities.
· Manage mobile application state, API communication, error handling, local persistence, release builds, and application performance.
D. DevOps, Server & Deployment Management
· Containerize applications and supporting services using Docker and Docker Compose; maintain reliable environment configuration across development, staging, and production.
· Administer and troubleshoot application servers, preferably Linux-based environments, including services, networking, ports, SSL/TLS certificates, reverse proxies such as Nginx, storage, permissions, and resource usage.
· Support CI/CD pipelines, source control workflows, environment variables/secrets, deployment automation, backups, rollback procedures, and production releases.
· Monitor application and infrastructure health and diagnose production issues across services, containers, databases, logs, queues, caches, and network dependencies.
E. Logging, Monitoring & Reliability
· Implement structured application logging using Serilog and centralized log monitoring/analysis using Seq.
· Design meaningful logs, correlation identifiers, health checks, metrics, alerts, and diagnostics to support distributed systems and production troubleshooting.
· Improve application performance, scalability, resilience, fault handling, and availability through profiling, testing, and operational monitoring.

· Write unit and integration tests and perform API, frontend, and mobile validation before release.
· Apply secure coding practices for authentication, authorization, secrets, data protection, input validation, dependency management, and API security.
· Participate in technical design, sprint planning, backlog refinement, code reviews, Git workflows, troubleshooting, and documentation.
· Produce clear technical documentation for architecture, APIs, deployments, integrations, and operational procedures.
