Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related field, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience.
Strong professional experience building full-stack production applications, with .NET Core / ASP.NET Core as the primary backend technology.
Hands-on experience with microservices, REST APIs, SQL Server, Entity Framework Core, Redis caching, RabbitMQ messaging, Serilog, and Seq.
Hands-on experience with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and modern frontend development practices.
Hands-on experience developing mobile applications with Flutter/Dart and integrating Firebase services.
Practical experience with Docker/containerization, Git, server administration, application deployment, and production troubleshooting.
Good understanding of software architecture, security, performance, scalability, concurrency, testing, and distributed-system fundamentals.
Ability to independently analyze technical problems, communicate clearly, document solutions, and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Good command of English for technical documentation and communication; Dari and/or Pashto are advantageous.
Preferred / Advantageous Experience
API gateways/reverse proxies (for example YARP or Nginx), CQRS/Mediator patterns, background workers, scheduled jobs, and distributed tracing.
CI/CD platforms, cloud or VPS environments, DNS/SSL management, backups, monitoring, and production incident response.
Experience integrating ERP/CRM, logistics, warehouse, cargo, payment, notification, or other enterprise systems.
Experience with Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, automated testing, code quality tools, and Agile/Scrum delivery.

Submission Guideline
Please send your CV and a brief cover letter to careers@moamlogistics.com . Strong communication, coordination, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively with different hospital departments.

HMIS operation, management, and monitoring.
HMIS user support and staff training.
Data quality monitoring and reporting.
Information security and confidentiality.
Communication, coordination, and teamwork.

title: Cloud Support Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Cloud Support Engineer to build a career with Canonical and support the technical needs of customers leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have an affinity for open source development and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical .
While our engineers regularly solve deeply interesting, complex technical problems - from triaging cloud environments to root-cause analysis on unseen Linux kernel crashes - this is fundamentally a role rooted in human connection. You will act as a trusted peer and technical guide to external engineering teams, translating intricate open-source challenges into clear, empathetic solutions. We are rapidly expanding and looking for brilliant problem solvers who are just as passionate about building strong, collaborative relationships with customers as they are about the next generation of Canonical solutions.
Location: This is a globally remote role.
The role entails
Empathetic Engagement: Partner directly with customers across remote sessions, ticketing,, and live conversations to deeply understand and resolve their technical roadblocks.
Collaborative Problem Solving: Work hand-in-hand with internal engineering teams and regional peer groups to bridge the gap between complex code fixes and real-world customer satisfaction.
True Ownership: Manage your support cases with a strong sense of personal integrity, ensuring commitments are honored and customer expectations are communicated transparently and predictably.
Ubuntu Lifecycle Guidance: Develop a rich understanding of the Ubuntu development process, empowering you to give customers clear, human context regarding timelines for engineering fixes.
Knowledge Advocacy: Author and maintain accessible knowledge base articles, ensuring lessons learned are shared openly to elevate the entire open-source community.
Operational Reliability: Participate in a regular weekend working rotation to maintain seamless, high-touch continuity of care for our global partners.
What are we looking for in you
Communication Excellence: Exceptional written and spoken English, with a natural ability to convey technical complexity clearly, warmly, and compellingly.
The Soft-Skill Edge: A genuine passion for helping people, paired with the emotional intelligence to navigate high-stakes technical situations with composure and empathy.
Academic Dedication: Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.
Educational Background: An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.
Driven Mindset: A proven track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to deliver meaningful, outstanding results for teams or customers.
Linux & Cloud Familiarity: Practical, hands-on experience supporting Linux systems, with an exposure to three or more of the following:
Virtualization & Cloud: Using KVM or OpenStack.
Containers: primarily Docker, LXD/LXC, or Kubernetes.
Storage Ecosystems: Block, object, and network storage technologies.
System Networking: Navigating bonding, firewalls, bridging, switching, or MTU tuning.

title: Advisor, Financial Systems & Digital Infrastructure (Retainer)
description:
About UNOPS
Background Information - UNOPS
UNOPS – an operational arm of the United Nations – supports the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) by successfully implementing its partners’ peacebuilding, humanitarian, and development projects around the world. Our mission is to help people build better lives and countries achieve peace and sustainable development.
UNOPS areas of expertise cover infrastructure, procurement, project management, financial management, and human resources.
Working with us
We are proud of our people. With a wealth of knowledge and skills in various disciplines – engineering, finance, human resources, ICT, leadership, project management, procurement, and more – they help tackle some of the biggest challenges of our time. Their work around the world supports progress toward the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
At UNOPS, we offer a range of short- and long-term opportunities in various environments and duty stations – from Denmark and Kenya to Mexico, Switzerland, Myanmar, Senegal, Uganda, and many more.
Diversity
With over 5,000 UNOPS personnel and approximately 7,400 personnel recruited on behalf of our partners, spread across 80 countries, our workforce represents a range of nationalities and cultures. We promote a balanced and diverse labor force — a strength that helps us better understand and address our partners’ needs. We continually strive to maintain our gender-balanced workplace. We encourage qualified underrepresented groups as per UNOPS Gender, Diversity, and Inclusion Strategy to apply for our vacancies.

Job Descriptions
Afghanistan
With more than 20 years of experience in the country, UNOPS Afghanistan focuses on providing maximum support to the people of Afghanistan through the delivery of projects and services that improve the lives of people in need. The UNOPS Afghanistan Country Office (AFCO) serves as an organizational mechanism to deliver a range of projects for which UNOPS has been designated as the implementation agency. At present, UNOPS AFCO activities cover a range of sectors including humanitarian, basic human needs, cash for work, infrastructure, development, procurement and HR services.
The functional objective of UNOPS AFCO is to contribute to improving the lives of girls, boys, men and women living in Afghanistan. The aim of UNOPS AFCO is to provide efficient and cost-effective implementation services on behalf of all our partners to support the humanitarian response and development of the country. UNOPS AFCO’s mission is to exceed the expectations of all stakeholders in the delivery of AFCO services, at all times, in all places, in all circumstances, in order to improve the lives of Afghans in need.

Job Requirements
Job Specific Context
UNOPS is the Principal Implementing Agency (PIA) for the Private Sector Resilience Project (PSRP), financed by the World Bank (IDA and ARTF), a project designed to support access to finance and capabilities of MSMEs in selected value chains.
This home-based retainer role is open to both National and International Applicants.
Role Purpose
The Advisor, Financial Systems & Digital Infrastructure will serve on an on-call, milestone-driven retainer basis. The Advisor provides senior technical leadership and policy guidance to the project team and implementing partners. The primary objective is to advise on activities supporting the modernization and resilience of the financial ecosystem in Afghanistan, and advise on knowledge activities, specifically related to financial sector development, credit information sharing systems, digital finance expansion, and shared agent networks. To this end, the retainer will engage with the project team, specialized service providers, project implementing partners, and other stakeholders as required.
Functions / Key Results Expected
1 . Technical Advisory
Serve as the principal technical expert on digital financial infrastructure, retail payment networks, and retail financial ecosystem modernization for the PSRP project.
Provide expert advice and guidance to the Senior Programme Manager (SPM) and project team on relevant areas of the project.
Contribute to the planning of knowledge products and technical diagnostics focused on structural solutions for the Afghanistan’s financial ecosystem, including digital payment systems and agent banking.
Provide strategic technical advice on the design and implementation of Credit Information Sharing Systems to enhance MSME access to formal finance.
Advise on the operationalization and scaling of Shared Agent Networks (SAN), focusing on low-cost delivery models that extend financial access to women-led MSMEs and rural populations.
Stay abreast of global and national regulatory shifts and technical developments in digital asset routing, mobile wallet licensing, and retail payment interoperability frameworks.
Analyze and map the evolving regulatory environment, assessing specific impacts on retail payment interoperability, digital micro-credit origination, and the liquidity requirements for financial sector actors.
2. Stakeholder Engagement and Coordination
Liaise and advise PSRP’s implementing partners on technical matters related to financial sector development.
Under the guidance of the SPM, liaise closely with technical stakeholders in the World Bank and IFC (particularly the Task Team Leads or their delegated technical representatives) on technical matters.
Ensure the PSRP is adequately represented and contributes to wider discussions and working groups on financial sector development; engage in technical meetings and workshops with stakeholders and the donor.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders to ensure effective collaboration and project success.
Work with financial service providers to identify obstacles to expanding foreign correspondent relationships and areas to support risk management processes.
Coordinate with other project implementing agencies working on microfinance and credit guarantees to ensure complementarity and cross-component learning of activities.
3. Technical Review
Review and provide technical input on terms of reference (ToRs), tender documents, and proposals for the procurement of specialized technical services.
Review and provide technical input on terms of reference, evaluations and other technical documents related to the contract management of PSRP grantees.
Review and provide technical inputs on deliverables from suppliers of specialised technical services contracted under the project, including but not limited to research and analysis work on credit information sharing systems and digital finance expansion.
Oversee, review, and guide the work of suppliers providing specialized technical assistance to financial service providers to improve financial integrity processes and digital service delivery.
4. Knowledge Sharing and Capacity Building
Contribute to knowledge sharing and capacity building initiatives within UNOPS and with project partners.
Develop and deliver training programs and workshops on private sector development topics.
Document and disseminate lessons learned and best practices from the project, facilitate knowledge exchange and learning events among project stakeholders.
Conduct field visits to project and partner sites to assess the effectiveness of interventions and provide on-site technical assistance.
Support the development of monitoring and evaluation frameworks to track project outcomes and impact.
Contribute to the preparation of project reports, briefs, and presentations for internal and external audiences.
Support the identification and assessment of potential private sector partners for project implementation.
Provide technical input into the design of new private sector development projects and initiatives.
Ensure gender and social inclusion considerations, and the adoption of sustainable and environmentally responsible practices, are integrated into all aspects of project design and implementation.
Skills
Capacity Building, Financial Advisory, Financial Regulations, Market Analysis, Policy Analysis, Public-private Partnerships, Technical Analysis
Competencies
Develops and implements sustainable business strategies, thinks long term and externally in order to positively shape the organisation. Anticipates and perceives the impact and implications of future decisions and activities on other parts of the organisation.
Treats all individuals with respect; responds sensitively to differences and encourages others to do the same. Upholds organisational and ethical norms. Maintains high standards of trustworthiness. Role model for diversity and inclusion.
Acts as a positive role model contributing to the team spirit. Collaborates and supports the development of others. For people managers only: Acts as positive leadership role model, motivates, directs and inspires others to succeed, utilizing appropriate leadership styles.
Demonstrates understanding of the impact of own role on all partners and always puts the end beneficiary first. Builds and maintains strong external relationships and is a competent partner for others (if relevant to the role).
Efficiently establishes an appropriate course of action for self and/or others to accomplish a goal. Actions lead to total task accomplishment through concern for quality in all areas. Sees opportunities and takes the initiative to act on them. Understands that responsible use of resources maximizes our impact on our beneficiaries.
Open to change and flexible in a fast paced environment. Effectively adapts own approach to suit changing circumstances or requirements. Reflects on experiences and modifies own behavior. Performance is consistent, even under pressure. Always pursues continuous improvements.
Evaluates data and courses of action to reach logical, pragmatic decisions. Takes an unbiased, rational approach with calculated risks. Applies innovation and creativity to problem-solving.
Expresses ideas or facts in a clear, concise and open manner. Communication indicates a consideration for the feelings and needs of others. Actively listens and proactively shares knowledge. Handles conflict effectively, by overcoming differences of opinion and finding common ground.
Education Requirements
Required
Master's degree in Finance, Financial Technology (FinTech), Banking, Economics, Business Administration, or related field with a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience; OR
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Financial Technology (FinTech), Banking, Economics, Business Administration, or related field with a minimum of 9 years of relevant experience.
Desired
Relevant certifications in financial services, including regulatory compliance.
Experience Requirements
Required
Minimum 7 years of experience in digital financial services, microfinance, banking sector development, or financial inclusion programs is required.
Experience in stakeholder engagement and partnership building with representatives from the private sector, government, and donor communities is required.
Experience in conducting high-quality market research and policy analysis related to financial sector development, including the preparation of comprehensive reports and policy recommendations is required.
Desired
Experience in financial sector development in fragile and conflict-affected contexts.
Technical experience in designing or implementing digital financial systems, credit registries, or interoperable payment architectures.
Proven track record in advising on the implementation of Shared Agent Networks or credit information systems.
Understanding of the economic, political, and social context of Afghanistan, with specific knowledge of the challenges and opportunities for financial sector development.
Experience in developing and delivering training programmes.
Experience in Afghanistan or other conflict-affected countries.

title: جین سکونسنگ دیتا انالیست (Gene Sequencing Data Analyst)
description:
Role Summary
هدف وظیفه: تبدیل ارقام تولید شده خام از توالی جین ها (Next Generation Sequencing – NGS) مانند (پنل سرطانی، اگزوم، جینوم) در
لابراتور مرکزی (ریفرنس) به معلومات قابل تطبیق در ساحات کلینیکی جهت استفاده شفاخانه ها و مراکز صحی بخاطر حمایت از پروسه تشخیص و
انتخاب شیوه های مناسب تداوی نزد مریضان و تصمیم گیری مبتنی برشواهد، تضمین کیفیت و اعتبار ارقام، تثبیت وریانت های جنتیکی، تفسیر درست
وریانت ها، ارائه راپور ها و گزارشات با کیفیت بالا و حفظ مؤثریت لابراتوار ریفرنس مطابق به اصول و مقررات وزارت.

Duties and Responsibilities
وظایف و مسئولیت ها:
وظایف اساسی:
1. کنترول کیفیت (Quality Control) ارقام خام بدست آمده از توالی یابی جنیتیک Next Generation Sequencing(NGS) با استفاده از میتود (FastQ files).
2. ارزیابی شاخص های عمق پوشش (Coverage)، کیفیت پایه /اساس (Base Quality)، میزان آلودگی و یکنواختی توالی‌یابی، شناسایی و حذف ارقام بی اعبتار.
3. طی یک سلسله مراحل بیوانفورماتیک (Alignment به ژنوم مرجع، Variant Calling) پی در پی در کمپیوتر که ارقام خام تولید شده از توالی یابی جین ها (NGS) را به معلومات تبدیل مینماید.
4. شناسایی واریانت‌ها، (Variant Calling / Detection) مانند Single Nucleotide Variant (SNV), Interstation /Deletion(Indel)
CNV (Copy Number Variation), Fusion وغیره.
5. تحلیل و تشریح تغیرات ایجاد در واریانت‌ها با استفاده ازذخایر ارقام (دیتابیس) های مانند (ClinVar، gnomAD، COSMIC، HGMD و ...)
6. فیلتر نمودن واولویت‌بندی واریانت‌های کلینیکی مرتبط و طبقه‌ بندی واریانت‌ها به اساس رهنمود های ACMG/AMP (Pathogenic، Likely Pathogenic، VUS، Benign و ...)
7. بررسی ارتباط واریانت با مرض یا پاسخ به تداوی (به ‌ویژه درسرطان وبیماری‌های ژنتیکی).
8. شریک ساختن نتایج با پاتولوژیست و سایر متخصصین و مسؤلین ذیربط غرض تأیید نهایی (Sign-out).
9. رعایت زمان پاسخ‌دهی (Turnaround Time)
10. سهم گیری فعال در اعتبارسنجی (Validation) معاینات انجام شده جدید در بخش NGS.
11. ذخیره ونگهداری مصؤن ارقام ومعلومات تهیه شده
12. همکاری نزدیک با تکنشین‌های مربوط به مالیکولر بیولوژی ، مالیکولر بیولوژی بیولوژیست‌ها و پاتولوژیست‌ها
13. مشارکت در کنترل کیفیت لابراتوار مربوط (مطابق ISO 15189)
14. ارائه مشوره های تخصصی و پشتیبانی از موارد پیچیده وراجع شده غرض معاینه ، تحلیل وتفسیر به لابراتوار به هدایت مقامات ذیربط.
15. مستند سازی دقیق نتایج، نگهداری سوابق و تهیه گزارش‌های علمی، نشر و پخش نتایج دریافت ها در قالب مقالات یا گزارش‌های فنی به مراجع ذیربط.
16. حفظ و نگهداشت مصؤن، کالیبریشن و حصول اطمینان از فعال بودن درست و سایل و تجهیزات مورد استفاده در لابراتوار مربوط.
17. آموزش و رهنمایی کارکنان لابراتوار مربوط، ترینی ها، ستاژران، کارکنان لابراتوار های ساحوی، کارکنان جدید، دربخش استفاده از تکنیک‌های مالیکولی و میتود های جدید، سهم گیری در تحقیقات علمی، سمینارها و ورکشاپ های آموزشی .
18. انکشاف متداوم دانش مسلکی و قابلیت های وظیفوی خودی.
19. رعایت اصول و معیارات اخلاق طبابت و مسلک گرایی طبی و ترویج آن بین کارکنان تحت اثر و سایر همکاران.
وظایف مدیریتی :
1. تهیه و ترتیب پلان کاری ماهوار، ربعوار و سالانه در مطابقت با پلان عمومی اداره مربوط جهت بدست آوردن اهداف تعیین شده.
2. ارایه گزارش ماهوار، ربعوار و سالانه و عندالضرورت از فعالیت ها و دست آورد های بخش مربوطه به آمر بخش مربوطه.
3. اجرای سایر وظایف مرتبط به وظیفه که مطابق قوانین، مقررات، پالسی ها از طرف آمر مربوطه به وی سپرده میشود.
وظایف هماهنگی :
1. تامین ارتباط وهماهنگی با بخش های ذیربط.

Job Requirements
شرایط استخدام:
· داشتن تابعیت افغانستان .
سویه تحصیلی : داشتن سند تحصیلی حد اقل لسانس در رشته علوم بیومیدیکل/ لابراتوار کلنیکی یا تکنالوژی طبی با تائید شده وزارت تحصیلات عالی و داشتن سند فالوشیپ 2 ساله جین سکونسنگ دیتا انالیست تحصیلات بالا تر در بخش علوم بیومیدیکل و انفورماتیک ارجهیت دارد .
تجربه کاری : داشتن تجربه کاری مرتبط به وظیفه مطابق به معیارات قید شده در رهنمود NTA.
مهارت های لازم:
· دانش قوی در علم جنتیک انسانی، مالیکیولر بیولوژی
· تسلط به وسایل بیوانفورماتیک مورد استفاده در امور روزمره (GATK، bwa، Sam tools، ANNOVAR و ...) استفاده از برنامه های کنترول کیفیت (FastQC, MultiQC) در بخش مربوط و داشتن قابلیت استفاده از برنامه ها در (Python، R، Bash).
· تسلط به یکی از زبان ‌های رسمی افغانستان (پشتو یا دری)، تحریر و تکلم روان به یکی از لسان های بین المللی.
· داشتن مهارت ‌های مرتبط به انجام بهتر وظایف در برنامه های کمپیوتر.

Submission Guidelines
رهنمود اعلان :
کاندیدان محترم می توانند سی وی خویش را مطابق اعلان به ایمیل آدرس moph.gdsa@gmail.com ارسال نمایید و یا هارد کاپی آن را به وزارت صحت عامه ریاست عمومی امور کارکنان مدیریت عمومی اعلانات و کاریابی تسلیم نمایید

title: ML Inference Engineer – Terminal-Bench Task Designer
description:
Headquarters:
Overview
We are building a benchmark that tests how well AI agents handle real expert work in a terminal. We are hiring ML inference and serving experts to turn real, paid tasks from their jobs into expert-level Terminal-Bench challenges. Each task includes the environment, a working solution, and an automated check that proves the result is correct.
***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***
Responsibilities
• Design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks that turn real, paid ML inference work from your own experience into challenges an AI agent must solve end to end.
• Define the files, systems and environments each task runs on, such as model serving with streaming, so the challenge is realistic, reproducible and command-line solvable.
• Write a working reference solution for every task and verify it runs end to end, sized for about 60 to 75 minutes of expert effort.
• Build automated checks that objectively prove a result is correct, including cases where ML outputs go wrong silently, such as numerical drift or metric bugs.
• Package tasks with Docker and Git so they are reproducible, and document the systems, tools, data and rules involved so reviewers can validate difficulty.
• Iterate on tasks based on reviewer feedback and agent test runs, adjusting difficulty and fixing ambiguities so each task stays expert-level, fair and objectively gradable.
Skills/Experience
• 3+ years doing ML inference or serving work hands-on (not only studying, selling or managing it), or a PhD plus active research in the subfield
• Did this work in the last 3 years and can name the systems, tools, data and rules used
• Trained, served or evaluated models at real scale (multi-GPU or production serving), not only notebooks or API calls
• Hands-on with PyTorch or JAX internals and serving stacks such as vLLM, SGLang or TensorRT-LLM
• Can explain how ML results go wrong without errors (numerical drift, metric bugs) and how to catch them
• Technical fluency in Python and the command line, and with files, CSV/JSON, APIs or databases
• Availability to start by early November 2026 and complete tasks of about 60 to 75 minutes each
Nice-to-have
• AI lab or LLM infrastructure experience
• Contributions to PyTorch, vLLM or SGLang
• GPU profiling experience
• Docker and Git proficiency
• Experience writing automated tests
Process
• Task vetting instead of an interview: complete a vetting task so the client can assess your task design
• Paid per task; each task takes about 60 to 75 minutes
• Work is delivered task by task, with reviewer feedback on submissions
• Expected start in early November 2026
To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-ml-inference-engineer-terminal-bench-task-designer

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Job Description:
B12 's engineering team views software as a craft, but improving the world as the reason to practice it. Our engineers are responsible for prioritizing, conceptualizing, co-designing, building, testing, and engaging users for any concept we are building out. We’re generalists in encouraging each other to experience the full stack, but we’re also aware of each other’s preferences in the stack. For this role in particular, we’re searching for a tenured full-stack engineer who brings strong backend/infrastructure skills (and an interest in using them) to the product. We mentor and teach where we can, both inside and outside of the company, and as a Staff Software Engineer, you will be responsible not only for your ownership of major projects, but also mentorship of the team members with whom you ship those projects.
We value sharing our work with the outside world. Our team has published papers on forming expert flash teams and machine-mediated worker hierarchies. We’ve baked our research into various open source tools in the space of creativity, expertise, and knowledge work.
We hope our engineers have more longevity than any one tool we use, but here is a sampling of our current thoughts about technology:
We live on Python/Django and TypeScript/React.
We store blobs in Amazon’s S3, munch on them in Amazon’s EC2, develop in Docker, and deploy containers to Amazon’s Elastic Beanstalk.
We believe PostgreSQL should be the first system you consider when thinking about persisting structured data.
We clean and centralize data in Amazon’s Redshift, and are able to answer almost any question in SQL.
We leverage AI in our product and our internal tooling, and faced with a landscape in constant flux, try to pick the right model or agent on a task-by-task basis.
Our new code is almost 100% LLM-generated, and we’ve thought hard about ensuring quality in the face of ever-increasing review loads, what processes humans are still best at, and how the practice of mentorship must adapt in the face of these new tools.
We have near-full test coverage on the backend, and are making progress on our frontend and integration tests.
We set up continuous integration and deployment because, while this model comes with its own pains, we’ve disliked being on fixed release schedules on previous projects.
We like to move fast and support point-in-time recovery :).
You’d be a good fit if
You have 10 or more years of experience building products and systems in production.
You are an amazing communicator.
You feel comfortable managing your time and deciding among competing priorities.
You are curious.
You have a high ownership mentality.
You enjoy learning and teaching.
You are comfortable working with backend and frontend technologies, but have a deeper background and interest on the backend/infrastructure side.
You care about and want to contribute to our mission of helping people do meaningful work.
What does a staff engineer do here?
This is B12 ’s first Staff Engineer hire on a ~10-person product team that includes a designer, product manager, and CTO. To understand what we’re looking for in someone with this much experience, here are some concrete examples of tasks you’d work on in a month:
Own the delivery of a project of the magnitude “we ship one or two of these a quarter,” both individually shipping code and rallying and supporting team members in doing so.
Participate in quarterly planning to identify key projects to work on next quarter.
Mentor other engineers who are in the planning, prototyping, or implementation phases of a project.
Respond to an incident, write up a postmortem, and improve tooling and infrastructure to help us prevent or more quickly respond to the issue and others like it in the future.
Identify and optimize some infrastructure that costs too much, is too slow, or isn’t stable enough.

…

title: Cryptography Specialist for AI lab
description:
Headquarters:
Overview
A fast-growing AI evaluation company is building expert-level benchmarks that test how well AI agents handle real professional work in the terminal. We are hiring cryptography experts to turn real, paid tasks from their own work into end-to-end challenges for AI agents, each with a working solution and a check that proves the result is correct.
***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***
Responsibilities
• Design expert-level Terminal-Bench cryptography tasks by turning real, paid work from your own experience into challenges that an AI agent must solve end to end.
• Define the task environment, including files, systems, ciphertexts and data, so the challenge is realistic, self-contained and reproducible in a Linux command-line setup.
• Write a working reference solution in Python or SageMath that proves the task is solvable, for example by recovering a key or decrypting a secret.
• Build automated checks and tests that objectively verify the final result is correct, and explain how a mistake or a partial answer would be detected.
• Calibrate task difficulty so a typical expert needs about 60-75 minutes to solve it, keeping it hard for AI agents while still fair and unambiguous.
• Package each task with Docker and Git where applicable, document instructions clearly, and revise based on reviewer feedback until it meets the required quality bar.
Skills/Experience
• 3+ years of hands-on cryptanalysis or applied cryptography; GRC, audit-only, policy, sales or management roles do not count, nor does coursework only
• Did the work in the last 3 years and can name the systems, tools, data and rules used
• Uses the low-level tools of the subfield, such as SageMath and Python, and works comfortably on the Linux command line
• Can show how a finding is proven, such as a decrypted secret or a recovered key, and explain how a mistake would be caught
• Technical fluency with files, CSV/JSON, APIs or databases
• Available to start around November 2026
Nice-to-have
• Published write-ups or research on cryptanalysis
• Strong CTF results, especially in crypto categories
• CVEs discovered in cryptographic implementations
• Experience with Docker, Git and writing automated tests
• Proficiency in C for low-level cryptographic work
Process
• Task vetting: complete a vetting task instead of a live interview
• Work is paid per task, with each task taking roughly 60-75 minutes
• Expected start around early November 2026
To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-cryptography-specialist-for-ai-lab

description:
The Agency Fund is a nonprofit innovation lab working to expand human agency — the capability for individuals to navigate toward the future that they want.
We combine the agility of a startup with the reach of a global network, building projects at the intersection of technology, AI, and social science. Our small, distributed team brings together engineers, designers, researchers, and strategists who care deeply about using technology for human good.
We’ve partnered with 200+ organizations worldwide, reaching millions annually through digital tools, behavioral insights, and scalable interventions. We value curiosity, autonomy, and collaboration — and we operate more like a mission-driven startup than a traditional NGO.
We have built and commercialized tech platforms that optimize NGO operations and strengthen their ability to learn and adapt through experimentation, automation, and better data use. We are now looking for a seasoned software engineer to join our team (as a contract role), contributing expertise while building with our partner NGOs.
What you'll do:
Be agentic by fostering a culture of proactive problem-solving and initiative-taking
Build reference codebases for the social sector to learn from and adapt
Provide advice and support to NGOs building generative AI products
Streamline data across different sources to create a single source of truth for all analytics within a given organization
Open-source any non-trivial innovations that come out of our in-kind work
Create internal tools to run various experiments across digital services, such as content, schedule, and nudges
Participate in organizing workshops and seminars on a variety of topics, from cultivating research mindsets to innovations in personalizing interventions
Conduct site visits to observe NGO operations and draft recommendations to address technical needs
Ship fast by implementing rapid development and deployment cycles to deliver solutions efficiently and iteratively
Be a mentor to NGOs, demonstrating industry best practices, culture and tooling to the staff we may work with, helping to grow these capabilities from within as well
Who you are:
5+ years of relevant engineering experience at tech and product-driven companies
Proficient with TypeScript, React, and other web technologies
Are proficient with a backend language (the company uses Python)
Experience in proposing, designing, and running rigorous experiments with clear insights and product recommendations using R, SQL, or Python
Experience with relational databases like PostgreSQL or MySQL
Proficient in data engineering and integrating diverse data sources
Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Must have interest in large language models (LLMs) and generative AI
Bonus points if you have:
Experience working remotely and across time zones.
Why Join The Agency Fund
True Flexibility and Remote-First Culture: We believe in results over rigid schedules. As a globally distributed team, we have built a culture that supports you doing your best work, wherever and whenever that is.
Global Collaboration: Join a small, talented, and mission-driven team distributed across the globe.
Collaborate with Bold Thinkers: Work alongside experts in software, AI, social psychology, and development economics who are solving complex global problems.
Mission-Driven Impact: The Agency Fund is focused on expanding human agency. Your work will directly contribute to projects that improve health outcomes, social impact, and expand the capabilities of millions through AI and data-driven technology.
Compensation & Growth: We offer salaries benchmarked to be internationally competitive, paying higher than local market rates in most regions to attract world-class talent, while maintaining the sustainability of our non-profit mission.
Global Travel Opportunities: Opportunities for team meetups and project-related travel, contingent on visa acquisition.

title: Offensive Security Engineer
description:
About the role
Mission Strengthen Sporty’s offensive security posture by proactively testing and identifying vulnerabilities across our external perimeter, standalone virtual private servers (VPS), physical office infrastructure, and endpoint defenses. The Offensive Security Engineer owns the security testing, continuous perimeter monitoring, and reconnaissance across all Sporty Group external domains, websites, public IP blocks, and DNS configurations. This role works closely with IT, Network Engineering, SOC, and Security teams to convert external discovery, adversary emulation on EDR/XDR systems, and exploitation insights into tuned perimeter controls, firewall rules, and robust defensive guardrails.
What you'll be doing
Monitor, map, and test Sporty’s entire external attack surface, including all Sporty Group external domains, subdomains, websites, and public IP addresses.
Conduct adversary emulation exercises against internal and office endpoints to validate the effectiveness of EDR, XDR, and SOC monitoring platforms.
Evaluate the security posture of physical office hardware, corporate network equipment, and internal edge infrastructure.
Perform scoped offensive testing on external-facing web applications and limited, public-facing API endpoints.
Translate external discovery, DNS security posture, network access control weaknesses, and EDR emulation findings into repeatable defensive checks.
Support our Purple Team validate that EDR policies, perimeter controls, firewall rules, and network segmentation work as expected.
Document multi-stage network or system exploitation chains to provide practical, reproducible remediation blueprints for infrastructure and SOC teams.
Support IT and Network analysts with clear vulnerability descriptions, triage steps, severity logic, and escalation guidance.
Improve external asset tracking, perimeter health records, and exposure trend mapping.
Track external vulnerability gaps, emulation success rates, remediation times, asset health, and perimeter exposure.
What you'll bring
Experience in offensive security, perimeter penetration testing, network security assessments, or adversary emulation.
Strong understanding of external asset discovery, DNS configuration vulnerabilities, and public IP network routing.
Practical experience auditing and testing Linux and Windows environments and underlying network services.
Ability to perform adversary emulation and bypass techniques against modern EDR/XDR solutions.
Familiarity with testing physical office network hardware, routers, switches, firewalls, and workplace IT systems.
Ability to turn external exposures and technical network risks into clear, actionable fixes for IT and Security teams.
Experience with core web vulnerabilities and limited, scoped testing of modern API interfaces.
Strong scripting ability in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar to automate perimeter mapping, emulation workflows, and asset discovery.
Good understanding of scanning, reconnaissance, and interception tools.
Strong documentation skills.
Technology Expertise Any of the following: Kali Linux toolset, Nmap, Shodan, Censys, Masscan, Amass, Dig/DNS testing tools, Wireshark, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Microsoft Defender XDR, CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne, Atomic Red Team, Caldera, Python, PowerShell, Bash, VPS environments (Linux/Windows Server OS), Firewalls, Routers, Git, Jira, Confluence
What's in it for you
Sporty is a remote-first company in pursuit of sustainability
A competitive salary plus individual performance-based bonuses every quarter
28 days paid annual leave
Core working hours of 10am-3pm in your local time zone, with flexibility outside of these hours
Referral bonuses and flash bonuses

Annual company retreats that provide opportunities to connect and collaborate with colleagues from around the world

title: Product Engineer (PM)
description:
Location: Fully Remote
Compensation: $23.08 to $34.62 USD/hour
Benefits: 15 days PTO. Christmas Day and New Year's Day paid off.
Fair warning: the pace is intense and the ambiguity is real. But you'll feel yourself growing every single week, even the rough ones, and you'll be doing it next to people who actually celebrate your wins and have your back.
We're the all-in-one agentic marketing platform. AI-native from day one. We're not joining a category, we're defining it.
We're looking for a Product Engineer to own a pod's output end-to-end: strategy, specs, QA, and enough technical depth to unblock engineers or write the code yourself when that's the fastest path forward. If you want real ownership, move fast, and raise the bar every week, keep reading. If you've been waiting for a PM role that doesn't ask you to leave your technical background at the door, this is it.
What you'll own
Own the roadmap for your pod: define what gets built, kill low-leverage work, and protect your engineers' time and focus
Write specs that start with the problem, not the solution, and ship every brief with a clear success criterion
Participate technically: read the codebase, debug independently, and ship small things when it's faster than context-switching an engineer
Own QA end-to-end: test plans, regression passes, release sign-off, and post-deploy monitoring in Sentry and Grafana
Keep the pod moving: fast decisions, async-first communication, and zero ambiguity about what's next
Close the feedback loop between customers, data, and product direction, and hold yourself accountable to the KPIs you define
You'll thrive here if...
You've shipped production code before and you're honest with yourself about your technical depth
You treat a spec as a hypothesis to pressure-test, not a document to execute against
You don't wait to be told what to do. You see the gap and you move.
Deadlines don't rattle you. Ambiguity doesn't either.
You're an AI power user, not someone who's "open to learning it someday."
You communicate clearly, especially when things are unclear.
You have opinions and you're not afraid to bring them.
You can laugh at a chaotic week on Friday and mean it.
What we're looking for
3+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, startup or high-growth environment
A hands-on technical background: production code, a bootcamp, or demonstrable ability to navigate a full-stack codebase
Comfortable reading Python and JavaScript/TypeScript; able to write SQL, reason about REST contracts, and follow frontend state
Proven QA ownership: test cases, regression cycles, structured bug reports, release sign-off
Daily fluency with Claude Code or equivalent. Not "open to it." Actually using it.
Strong written communication. Your specs are clear and complete on the first read.
Available in EST
What working here actually looks like
High expectations. Real ownership. Things change fast and we don't apologize for it. You'll work with smart people who push you, a product that keeps getting better, and a team that's genuinely building something new.
The boundary between product and engineering is intentionally blurred here. The best product decisions are inseparable from technical reality, and we hire people who understand that.
We'll probably give you more to own than you expected. That's on purpose.
We use AI every day, across every function. That's just how we work.
What we stand for
We are obsessed with our customers, and making them obsessed with us
We figure it the f**k out
We go to war on our problems quickly
We are strategic. We work smart, not just hard.
We're fun AF
About Search Atlas
Search Atlas helps marketing teams move faster, make smarter decisions, and do more with less. We're a $30M+ ARR company, 215 people, bootstrapped, and building the infrastructure for the next era of marketing. No outside funding. No fluff. Just product.

title: AI QA Trainer – LLM Evaluation
description:
Are you an AI QA expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into enterprise-grade platforms. With rigorous evaluation data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world-class education, keep pace with cutting-edge research, and streamline workflows for teams everywhere. We’re looking for AI QA trainers who live and breathe model evaluation, LLM safety, prompt robustness, data quality assurance, multilingual and domain-specific testing, grounding verification, and compliance/readiness checks. You’ll challenge advanced language models on tasks like hallucination detection, factual consistency, prompt-injection and jailbreak resistance, bias/fairness audits, chain-of-reasoning reliability, tool-use correctness, retrieval-augmentation fidelity, and end-to-end workflow validation—documenting every failure mode so we can raise the bar.

You’ll also partner on adversarial red-teaming, automation (Python/SQL), and dashboarding to track quality deltas over time.
A bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD in computer science, data science, computational linguistics, statistics, or a related field is ideal; shipped QA for ML/AI systems, safety/red-team experience, test automation frameworks (e.g., PyTest), and hands-on work with LLM eval tooling (e.g., OpenAI Evals, RAG evaluators, W&B) signal fit. Skills that stand out include: evaluation rubric design, adversarial testing/red-teaming, regression testing at scale, bias/fairness auditing, grounding verification, prompt and system-prompt engineering, test automation (Python/SQL), and high-signal bug reporting. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.
Ready to turn your QA expertise into the quality backbone for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

title: IT Manager / Managed IT Services (Open to Individuals & Companies)
salary: As per the Organization's salary scale
description:
Job Summary
Position Summary: Ariana Medical Complex invites qualified individual IT professionals and eligible IT companies or service providers to apply for the management and support of the hospital’s information technology systems.
The selected individual or service provider will be responsible for planning, managing, maintaining, securing, and improving the hospital’s IT infrastructure and services. These services must support the hospital’s clinical, administrative, financial, and operational activities while ensuring system reliability, information security, confidentiality of patient data, and continuity of essential hospital services.
Applicants may apply under one of the following categories:
Category A – Individual IT Manager: An experienced IT professional responsible for managing the hospital’s IT operations and supervising the hospital’s IT staff.
Category B – IT Company / Service Provider: A qualified company that provides IT management services through a designated IT manager and an appropriately skilled technical team under an agreement with the hospital.
Key Responsibilities:
A. Strategic Leadership and IT Governance
Develop and implement an IT strategy aligned with the hospital’s objectives and healthcare service requirements.
Establish, review, and maintain IT policies, procedures, technical standards, and operational controls.
Advise hospital management on technology investments, digital transformation, system improvements, and IT-related risks.
Develop an annual IT work plan, including priorities, resource requirements, maintenance schedules, and improvement activities.
Ensure IT operations support the hospital’s clinical, administrative, financial, and operational departments.
B. IT Operations and Infrastructure
Manage and maintain servers, computer networks, databases, applications, workstations, printers, scanners, switches, cameras, and related equipment.
Ensure the availability, performance, reliability, and proper functioning of critical hospital IT systems.
Manage network architecture, routing, connectivity, wireless networks, internet services, email systems, and internal communications.
Coordinate installation, configuration, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of IT equipment.
Maintain an updated inventory of IT equipment, software, licenses, systems, and related assets.
Minimize service interruptions and coordinate timely resolution of technical problems.
C. Information Security and Data Protection
Protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of hospital information and patient records.
Implement appropriate access controls, user account management, password policies, endpoint protection, and security monitoring.
Establish and maintain regular data backup, restoration testing, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures.
Monitor and address cybersecurity risks, vulnerabilities, unauthorized access, malware, and other security incidents.
Ensure that access to patient information is restricted to authorized personnel and permitted purposes.
Report significant security incidents promptly to the designated hospital authority.
Ensure that hospital data is not copied, transferred, disclosed, or used without proper authorization.
D. Systems Development and Improvement
Assess, recommend, install, configure, and maintain suitable hardware, software, and technology solutions.
Support the effective operation and improvement of hospital information systems, including clinical, administrative, financial, and other approved platforms.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend cost-effective solutions that improve hospital services.
Coordinate system upgrades, software updates, equipment replacement, and technical projects.
Ensure that changes to critical systems are properly authorized, documented, tested, and implemented.
E. IT Support and Team Management
Provide or coordinate timely technical support to all hospital departments.
Supervise, guide, and evaluate hospital IT staff, where applicable.
Ensure proper allocation of IT duties, technical coverage, staff development, and performance monitoring.
Establish a system for receiving, recording, prioritizing, tracking, and resolving IT support requests.
Provide advanced technical assistance for complex IT and system-related issues.
Maintain appropriate technical coverage for critical hospital services, including agreed arrangements for urgent and after-hours support.
F. Budget, Procurement, and Vendor Management
Prepare or contribute to the annual IT budget, equipment replacement plan, and maintenance requirements.
Recommend cost-effective procurement of IT equipment, software, licenses, and technical services.
Coordinate with authorized hospital departments regarding procurement specifications, vendor evaluation, and technical acceptance.
Manage technical relationships with internet providers, software vendors, equipment suppliers, and other service providers.
Monitor vendor performance, warranties, service agreements, licenses, and maintenance commitments.
Ensure that procurement and expenditure recommendations are submitted through the hospital’s approved authorization procedures.
G. Compliance, Documentation, and Reporting
Ensure compliance with hospital policies, applicable regulations, accreditation requirements, and approved information security procedures.
Maintain updated technical documentation, network diagrams, system configurations, equipment inventories, access records, and maintenance logs.
Prepare regular reports covering system availability, support requests, incidents, cybersecurity risks, completed activities, and proposed improvements.
Report major risks, service disruptions, resource gaps, and unresolved technical issues to the designated hospital authority.
Perform other relevant duties assigned by hospital leadership within the approved scope of work.
2. Confidentiality and Ownership of Hospital Information
The selected individual or company must:
Sign the required confidentiality and data protection undertaking before receiving access to hospital systems or information.
Use hospital data and systems solely for authorized purposes.
Maintain appropriate safeguards for patient information, employee records, financial information, and other confidential hospital data.
Refrain from retaining, disclosing, transferring, or using hospital information after termination of the engagement, except where expressly authorized or legally required.
Ensure that all hospital data, configurations, documentation, credentials, and other hospital-owned information remain under the hospital’s control.
Return hospital property and transfer all required records, documentation, credentials, and system access arrangements upon termination or completion of the assignment.
3. Deliverables and Performance Indicators
The selected individual or company will be expected to provide the following deliverables according to an agreed implementation schedule:
No.
Deliverable
Performance Indicator
1
Initial IT assessment and improvement plan
Assessment and prioritized action plan submitted and approved
2
IT asset and system inventory
Inventory maintained and updated
3
IT maintenance plan
Preventive maintenance conducted and documented
4
IT support and incident management
Requests recorded, tracked, and handled within agreed service levels
5
Data backup and recovery plan
Backups monitored and restoration tests documented
6
Information security measures
Access controls reviewed and security incidents reported
7
IT documentation
Essential technical documentation maintained and updated
8
Periodic performance reports
Reports submitted according to the agreed reporting schedule
9
Annual IT plan and budget recommendations
Submitted within the timeline approved by hospital management
10
Handover and continuity arrangements
Complete handover completed at the end of the engagement
Specific uptime targets, response times, resolution targets, and other service-level indicators shall be agreed upon in the contract or service agreement, taking into account the hospital’s operational requirements and available resources.

Job Requirements
4. Additional Requirements for Individual Applicants
Individual applicants must meet the following minimum requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. A master’s degree is an advantage.
At least five years of progressively responsible IT experience, including at least two years in a supervisory or managerial role.
Experience in server administration, network management, cybersecurity, backup systems, disaster recovery, and IT support.
Experience managing enterprise-level infrastructure; experience in a hospital or other healthcare institution is an advantage.
Strong leadership, planning, troubleshooting, communication, and decision-making skills.
High professional integrity and commitment to confidentiality and data protection.
Fluency in Dari, Pashto, and English, with the ability to communicate effectively in the languages required for the assignment.
Ability to provide the services and meet the attendance, availability, and reporting requirements agreed with the hospital.
5. Additional Requirements for IT Companies / Service Providers
Companies applying for this assignment must provide evidence of their ability to deliver reliable IT management services in a hospital environment.
Minimum requirements include:
Valid business registration and authorization to provide IT-related services under applicable Afghan laws and regulations.
Demonstrated experience in IT infrastructure management, technical support, networking, cybersecurity, systems maintenance, or related services.
A company profile describing its technical capabilities, service coverage, organizational structure, and relevant experience.
Evidence of previous relevant assignments, including client references or completion certificates where available.
A proposed service delivery team, including a designated IT Manager or Team Leader and appropriately qualified technical personnel.
CVs, educational qualifications, and relevant experience records for key personnel assigned to the hospital.
A technical proposal explaining the proposed management approach, service delivery arrangements, support coverage, escalation procedures, backup strategy, cybersecurity measures, and reporting arrangements.
A proposed service-level arrangement specifying response times, resolution targets, system monitoring, preventive maintenance, and emergency support.
A financial proposal detailing professional fees, staffing costs, maintenance charges, and any additional costs, clearly identifying applicable exclusions.
Written acceptance of the hospital’s confidentiality, patient data protection, access control, and information security requirements.
The company shall nominate a qualified person to serve as its primary contact and IT Manager for the assignment. Replacement of key personnel must be subject to prior approval by the hospital.
6. Evaluation and Selection Criteria
Applications will be evaluated according to the applicant category.
For individual applicants:
Educational qualifications and relevant certifications.
Years and relevance of IT management experience.
Technical competence and problem-solving ability.
Leadership and communication skills.
Healthcare or comparable enterprise IT experience.
Proposed approach to managing the hospital’s IT operations.
For companies / service providers:
Legal registration and eligibility.
Relevant company experience and past performance.
Qualifications and experience of the proposed IT Manager and technical team.
Technical proposal and service delivery methodology.
Availability, support coverage, cybersecurity, and continuity arrangements.
Financial proposal and overall value for money.
Ariana Medical Complex reserves the right to verify submitted documents, contact references, conduct interviews or technical assessments, request clarification, and select the applicant that best meets the hospital’s requirements, subject to its approved procedures.
7. Contractual and Administrative Arrangements
Individual applicants, if selected, shall enter into an employment or individual service contract, as determined by the hospital.
Companies, if selected, shall enter into a service agreement defining the scope of services, deliverables, staffing arrangements, service levels, payment terms, confidentiality obligations, performance monitoring, and termination conditions.
The final scope, contract duration, payment structure, working arrangements, and reporting requirements shall be agreed upon and approved by the hospital before commencement.
No applicant may access hospital systems or patient information before the required authorization and confidentiality arrangements are in place.
The hospital retains authority over strategic decisions, procurement approvals, system access authorization, and other reserved management functions.

Submission Guideline
8. Application Procedure
Interested individuals and eligible companies may submit their applications quoting the Job tile and the Vacancy Announcement Number (AMC | HRD-897) in the subject line to email.
Individual applicants should submit:
Updated CV.
Application letter.
Copies of educational certificates and relevant professional certifications.
Evidence of relevant work experience.
A brief technical approach to managing hospital IT services.
Fluency in English, Dari, and Pashto (spoken and written).
Companies / service providers should submit:
Company profile and valid registration documents.
Technical proposal and service delivery methodology.
Relevant contracts, references, or evidence of previous assignments.
CVs and qualifications of the proposed IT Manager and key technical personnel.
Proposed service-level arrangements and support coverage.
Detailed financial proposal.

title: Head of Technology
description:
Headquarters: New York City
URL: https://sanctuary.computer
We are hiring a Head of Technology for the garden3d creative collective, to lead engineering at Sanctuary Computer and garden3d in the era of agentic computer code.
Original job posting link
About garden3d
We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.
Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.
We’re the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.
We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.
Sanctuary Computer - Development
At Sanctuary Computer we’re building a different type of technology shop – one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.
Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.
XXIX - Design
When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and we’ve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.
We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.
Index - Community
Index is network of physical spaces all around the world, Index provides space for the exchange of knowledge and tools.
We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care.
garden3d TK — Media
At garden3d, we’re in the early stages of building an experimental media company exploring emerging themes related to the evolving landscape of technology, design and culture.
We aim to monetize this outlet, publish books, produce screenplays, and release music.
Plus, our partner organizations
Lightphone
Mill
IngredientAI
⛰️ The Head of Technology Role
The garden3d Head of Technology has one mandate: everything we build works, holds up in production, and gets built the smartest way available to us. We are a house of brands - Sanctuary Computer (development), XXIX (design), Index Space (community), USB Club (digital community), and the garden3d umbrella itself - and a lot of what all of them ship runs on software we wrote. Working in close partnership with our founder & president Hugh Francis, this person sets the engineering standard, and builds the culture that holds it.
You can be based anywhere. A lot of our people are in New York and there's some gravity here, but we already work across timezones and we would happily hire in Europe, Singapore, Chicago, or wherever you are. If you're the right person, we want to hear from you.
This role works with studio leads, developers, designers, project managers and clients across every garden3d vertical.
This person can move between a Rails migration, a Next.js app, a firmware release plan and an agent loop in the same week, and raise the bar on each of them.
They span all of garden3d, but their home base is Sanctuary Computer, where roughly 70% of their time goes. Our development studio is where the engineering standard gets set, and where it either holds or slips: architecture, code review, estimation, and the hardest technical calls on our biggest projects. The other 30% goes to garden3d's broader technology story: how we ship product for USB Club, build with agents across the collective, which tools and platforms we bet on, and what we build for ourselves.

Description
We are looking for a Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer to develop and operate GoMining's cloud platform.
The primary focus of this role is GCP and Kubernetes , infrastructure and application delivery automation, and the reliability and security of production services.
You will maintain and improve our existing infrastructure, contribute to the development of the next generation of our platform, and help product teams ship changes safely and efficiently.
Responsibilities
Develop and operate infrastructure in GCP , including GKE, virtual machines, networking, load balancers, storage, and managed services.
Manage Infrastructure as Code with Terraform : develop modules, manage state and dependencies, ensure reproducible changes, and identify configuration drift.
Operate Kubernetes : upgrade clusters and platform components, configure autoscaling, workload placement, network policies, and resource allocation.

Troubleshoot production incidents and performance issues, conduct root cause analysis, and eliminate recurring failure patterns.
Implement least-privilege access, environment and service isolation, secure secrets management and rotation, and infrastructure audit controls.
Maintain backup processes and regularly validate recovery of critical data and infrastructure according to agreed RPO/RTO .
Help engineering teams prepare services for production, including health checks, resource configuration, telemetry, and deployment procedures.
Optimize cloud infrastructure usage and costs while maintaining reliability requirements.
Maintain infrastructure documentation, operational runbooks, and recovery procedures.
Requirements
Strong hands-on experience independently operating production infrastructure and Kubernetes , including upgrades, troubleshooting, and disaster recovery.
Strong experience with GCP , including GKE, Compute Engine, VPC, IAM, and Cloud Storage; good understanding of Cloud SQL, Cloud Logging, and Cloud Monitoring.
Hands-on experience with Terraform , including modules, remote state, locking, importing existing resources, and safely applying infrastructure changes through CI.
Deep knowledge of Kubernetes and containerization : Deployments, StatefulSets, Services, Ingress, storage, requests/limits, probes, autoscaling, RBAC, and NetworkPolicy.
Experience with Helm and Kustomize .
Strong Linux administration skills, preferably Debian/Ubuntu: processes, systemd, filesystems, disks, and resource troubleshooting.
Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP(S), TLS, routing, NAT, load balancing, and firewalls.
Ability to troubleshoot connectivity issues across applications, Kubernetes clusters, networks, and cloud services.
Experience building CI/CD pipelines, preferably with GitLab CI , and strong understanding of Git and GitOps principles.
Understanding of runner permissions, secrets protection, and production deployment controls.
Automation skills with Bash and Python , including maintainable infrastructure scripts and API integrations.
Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Cloud Monitoring .
Practical experience operating PostgreSQL and understanding Redis and RabbitMQ, including availability, connections, replication or clustering, backup, and recovery.
Strong understanding of cloud security principles: least privilege, service accounts, Workload Identity, secrets management, network segmentation, and access auditing.
Ability to independently deliver infrastructure changes to a validated production result, explain technical trade-offs, and collaborate effectively with Engineering and Security teams.

title: DevOps Engineer (Vac DST)
description:
About Logos (λ)
Logos (λ) is a movement of technologists, creatives, strategists, and activists working together to build a sovereign, people-owned technology stack that revitalises civil society and protects digital liberties at scale.
This position is within the IFT Technical Services (IFT-TS) Distributed Systems Testing (DST) Team, a team that primarily supports Logos, while also contributing to other IFT projects.
The role
We are seeking an experienced Distributed Systems Evaluation Engineer to join the Institute of Free Technology - Technical Services, on the Distributed Systems Testing (IFT-TS DST) team. This role focuses on rigorously assessing the performance and reliability of IFT projects at scale, where Logos (λ) is one of them.
Logos (λ) technology stack is composed of 3 main components:
Logos (λ) Blockchain : Advanced privacy for a new era of decentralised applications and social institutions.
Logos (λ) Messaging : Private peer‑to‑peer communication that resists surveillance and censorship.
Logos (λ) Storage : Secure decentralised storage enabling fully decentralised apps and file sharing.
We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic DevOps Engineer to join our Distributed Systems Testing (DST) team.
You’ll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive evaluation strategies, leveraging both large-scale lab deployments and protocol behavior modeling scripts. Your expertise will be crucial in analyzing these complex distributed systems, automating intricate test scenarios, and providing in-depth insights into system behaviors.
Working closely with cross-functional teams, you’ll troubleshoot complex issues and translate technical data into actionable recommendations. Proficiency in containerization, cloud technologies, and distributed systems principles is essential.
Key responsibilities
Design, configure, and optimize Kubernetes clusters to support large-scale experiments and benchmarks of P2P technologies.
Continuously improve cluster scalability and resource utilization, enabling increasingly complex deployments and experiments.
Set up, maintain, and optimize supporting infrastructure such as monitoring, logging, and observability stacks (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, etc.).
Collaborate with DST researchers and engineers to streamline experimentation workflows and make analysis easier and more reproducible.
Automate infrastructure and deployment workflows to increase reliability and reduce overhead.
Troubleshoot, profile, and tune distributed workloads to ensure accurate and performant benchmarking.
Identify, reproduce, and debug complex issues in distributed systems, working closely with Logos development teams.
You ideally will have
Strong experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration in production or research environments.
Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure, Linux systems, and networking (especially relevant to distributed/P2P systems).
Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Grafana, Prometheus, VictoriaLogs, etc.).
Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible, Helm, etc.).
Proficiency in at least one scripting/programming language (ideally Python).
Interest in or experience with distributed systems, P2P networks, or blockchain technologies.
Experience with networks and systems programming.
Excellent written and conversational communication skills.
Alignment with our core values and principles.
Bonus points
Hands-on experience with libp2p or projects in the Logos collective.
Background in performance benchmarking, scalability testing, or systems research.
Contributions to open source projects.
Experience working for an open-source organization.
Interview Process
Interview with our POps team
Interview with team member from the IFT-TS DST team
Take-home assignment and discussion of results
Interview with IFT-TS team lead

Architecture : engineer the integration of open source from boot firmware to cloud applications deployment
Packaging : a combination of Debian and Snap packaging to ship software in the distribution
Automation : build and maintain the machinery responsible for building, testing and shipping Ubuntu

If you have skills in those areas, or you have other skills you believe could contribute to Ubuntu, and you're keen to get started building your career in open source, then this is the role for you. Our junior career path caters for both new graduates and early careers engineers.
At Canonical , you will have the opportunity to engage with and contribute to the broader open source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community and contribute with enthusiasm and precision to a broad range of technologies.

The role entails
Based on the first round of interviews, we identify specific teams where you might be an excellent fit and conduct second-round interviews with those teams. Our engineers are:
Designing, building and shipping software in Rust, Go, Python and C/C++
Packaging, integrating, testing and uploading open source software to the Ubuntu repositories
Debugging issues, then designing and delivering robust solutions

description:

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
THE COMMUNITY YOU WILL JOIN
Airbnb's Marketing Technology organization builds the infrastructure that powers how we reach and connect with guests and hosts around the world - from audience segmentation and campaign orchestration to last-mile delivery and real-time insights. Our engineers work at the intersection of scale, reliability, and product impact, building platforms that carry billions of messages each year across email, SMS, push, and WhatsApp. We are deeply committed to building AI-natively: agents and LLM-powered automation are becoming core to how we build, operate, and improve our systems.
You'll lead two closely partnered teams that together own Airbnb's communications platform end to end. The Orchestration team builds the systems that let marketing and product teams design and run personalized, event- and list-triggered customer journeys at Airbnb scale. The Delivery team owns the last mile - routing every notification through the right provider, tracking it to a terminal state, and managing contact preferences and vendor relationships. Both teams collaborate deeply with audience segmentation, content, ML, and data engineering teams, as well as product partners across the company.
THE DIFFERENCE YOU WILL MAKE
As the Engineering Manager for this team, you will be the primary technical leader for the systems that decide whether a message reaches a guest or host and when. You'll set the technical direction, own roadmap execution, and build the kind of team culture where engineers grow and do the best work of their careers, including through deep, genuine adoption of AI-native engineering practices.
The platform is mid-transformation. We are consolidating legacy and next-generation messaging flows onto a single unified path, moving platform health from component metrics to business-impact signals such as campaign delivery SLAs and burn rate, and building end-to-end observability so any owner, human or agent can answer "what happened to notification X for user Y" in minutes. At the same time, both teams are standing up agentic capabilities: an agent-driven orchestration layer, end-to-end lifecycle testing agents, smart notification scheduling, and AI-assisted on-call triage. You will be the leader who ensures these systems ship with the rigor, reliability, and operational maturity that production-grade messaging and agentic systems demand.
Your leadership will directly determine how reliably Airbnb communicates with its community, how confidently partner teams can build on the platform, and how effectively this team leads Marketing Technology's shift toward AI-native engineering.
A TYPICAL DAY
Lead planning, roadmap reviews, and cross-team syncs for Delivery and Orchestration, keeping delivery on track and stakeholders well-informed
Run 1:1s with engineers across both teams, with intentional focus on career growth, technical skill development, and early identification of blockers
Serve as the primary engineering point of contact for cross-team dependencies - fielding requests from product teams across Airbnb and making clear, reasoned prioritization calls
Partner with the Product Manager to sequence the roadmap across journey orchestration, bulk campaign sends, and delivery infrastructure
Drive technical strategy for end-to-end observability and SLA-driven delivery: campaign-level delivery tracking, health-gated ramping, dynamic pacing against budgets, and automatic provider failover
